results.description: Multitasking 5-in-1 concealer erases, perfects, brightens, hydrates and refreshes skin for a flawlessly awake look. Wears comfortably for up to 24 hours. results.description: Triumph & Disaster Rock & Roll Face Scrub is infused with a unique natural fragrance called 'Smoke and Wood'. Skin grows old and sheds naturally. Left to its own devices dead layers of skin will sit on the surface until they either flake or are brushed away. Regular exfoliation with a well-balanced and complete face scrub like Rock & Roll Scrub will remove this buildup of unwanted material, cleaning out dirty pores and revealing the fresh layers of newer skin underneath.

results.name: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Woman EDP 100ml
results.description: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Woman EDP 100ml is a fruity floral oriental fragrance for women, designed as the evening counterpart to the original Authentic Woman. At Eau de Parfum concentration, it carries more depth and staying power than a lighter daytime fragrance, making it better suited to evenings and cooler months. The character is warm and feminine — a fruity opening that gives way to a rich floral heart before settling into an earthy, woody base. It is a well-rounded fragrance that works across a range of evening occasions without being overly formal or heavy. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Black currant, apple, pink pepper Heart Notes: Tuberose, jasmine sambac, magnolia Base Notes: Patchouli, sandalwood, cedar Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Woman opens with a bright, fruity combination of black currant, apple, and pink pepper — fresh and slightly spiced, with enough energy to make an immediate impression. The heart transitions into tuberose, jasmine sambac, and magnolia, which add a creamy, rich floral warmth that softens the opening considerably. The base of patchouli, sandalwood, and cedar grounds the fragrance with an earthy, woody depth that lingers well on the skin. About The Fragrance Authentic Night Woman is part of the Authentic collection from Abercrombie & Fitch, a range built around the idea of genuine, unpretentious femininity. The Authentic line includes both daytime and evening versions, with the Night edition leaning into richer, warmer materials suited to after-dark wear. The fragrance family is fruity floral oriental — a popular category in women’s perfumery that balances sweet fruit notes with floral warmth and a grounding oriental base. Performance & Character At EDP concentration, longevity is solid — expect five to eight hours on skin, with the patchouli and sandalwood base persisting the longest. Projection is moderate on application, settling to a closer sillage after the first couple of hours. The overall character is warm, fruity, and feminine without being overpowering. It performs best in cooler temperatures where the base notes develop fully; in summer heat, the sweetness of the black currant and tuberose can become more prominent. When To Wear Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Woman EDP 100ml is best suited to autumn and winter evenings. The warmth of the floral heart and woody base make it a natural fit for dinners, events, and nights out. It is less suited to professional daytime environments or warm weather, where a lighter fragrance would be more appropriate. It works well as a casual evening scent and does not require a formal occasion to justify wearing it. Who Is It For? This fragrance suits women in their twenties through to forties who enjoy fruity floral fragrances with a warm, grounding base. It is a good choice for those who find purely floral fragrances too light or purely oriental fragrances too heavy — Authentic Night sits comfortably between the two. The 100ml size offers good value and is practical for regular evening wear through the cooler months. You Might Also Like Rabanne Olympea EDP 80ml — A powdery floral with a warm vanilla base. results.name: Lattafa Hayaati EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Hayaati EDP 100ml is an easy-wearing woody-aromatic fragrance that combines crisp apple and bergamot with warm cinnamon, smooth woods, musk and vanilla. The scent moves from bright fruit into a comfortable spicy-woody centre before settling into a clean, gently sweet base. Apple supplies a familiar juicy freshness while bergamot keeps the opening light and energetic. Cinnamon introduces warmth without turning the heart into a dense spice blend, and the woody accord gives the fragrance shape. Musk softens the finish as vanilla adds a restrained sweetness that makes Hayaati feel approachable for regular wear. Lattafa presents Hayaati as a fragrance for women and men. Its simple contrast of fresh fruit, warm spice and musky vanilla makes it useful for customers who want a versatile everyday scent rather than a challenging oud, tobacco or intensely gourmand composition. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Apple and bergamot. Heart Notes: Cinnamon and woody notes. Base Notes: Musk and vanilla. Scent Profile Hayaati begins clean and fruity, with apple carrying most of the opening and bergamot adding citrus lift. Cinnamon gradually warms the composition while smooth woody notes create a dry centre. The dry-down becomes softer as musk and vanilla emerge, producing a comfortable trail that balances freshness with gentle sweetness. It is straightforward, modern and designed for ease of wear. Who Is It For? Hayaati can be worn by anyone who enjoys apple, bergamot, cinnamon, woods, musk and vanilla. It is particularly suitable for fragrance newcomers, daily commuters, students and customers wanting an affordable signature scent that works across several settings. Those looking for very dark oud or highly complex niche development may prefer a richer Lattafa Pride option. When to Wear The balanced profile suits spring, autumn, mild winter days and cooler summer evenings in New Zealand. Wear it for work, study, errands, travel, casual dates, weekend plans and relaxed dinners. The fresh opening supports daytime use, while cinnamon and vanilla give the dry-down enough warmth for evening wear. Longevity & Sillage As an Eau de Parfum built around woods, cinnamon, musk and vanilla, Hayaati is designed to maintain a pleasant aromatic trail after the bright apple-bergamot opening fades. Projection is usually clearest early before the scent settles closer into its warmer base. Performance varies with skin, spray count, climate, clothing and storage. results.name: Lattafa Qaed Al Fursan EDP 90ml
results.description: Lattafa Qaed Al Fursan EDP 90ml is a fruity aromatic oud fragrance that opens with saffron and pineapple before moving into jasmine and fir balsam. Oud, cedarwood and amber create a deep woody base. The composition contrasts juicy tropical fruit with dry spice, evergreen resin and warm woods in a bold, streamlined style. Pineapple provides a ripe, vibrant opening while saffron adds dry warmth and a slightly leathery nuance. Jasmine brings floral lift through the heart, and fir balsam introduces a green resinous tone. Oud and cedarwood then darken the base, while amber softens the structure and helps connect the bright fruit to the woods. Lattafa’s page places Qaed Al Fursan in its men’s category but describes the fragrance for women and men. Its woody base leans assertive, while the pineapple opening gives it clear unisex appeal. It suits customers who enjoy fruit used as contrast within an oud fragrance rather than a sweet tropical gourmand. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Saffron and pineapple. Heart Notes: Jasmine and fir balsam. Base Notes: Oud, cedarwood and amber. Scent Profile The first spray is immediately pineapple-led, sharpened by saffron’s dry spice. As the fruit softens, jasmine adds a subtle floral bridge and fir balsam contributes an evergreen, slightly resinous character. Cedarwood makes the base dry and structured, oud adds depth and amber provides warmth. The fragrance moves from bright tropical fruit into green balsamic woods, then settles into a compact amber-oud trail with traces of saffron. Who Is It For? A good choice for any gender when pineapple, saffron, fir balsam, cedar and oud are appealing. It may suit someone exploring woody Middle Eastern fragrances through a familiar fruit opening. Customers wanting creamy vanilla, delicate powder, marine freshness or a complex floral bouquet should consider another profile. Begin lightly if saffron or oud tends to project strongly on your skin. When to Wear Useful across autumn, winter, spring, cool summer evenings, dinners, casual events, dates and outdoor social occasions. Pineapple gives it daytime energy, while fir, oud and amber support evening wear. In hot or enclosed conditions, use fewer sprays so saffron and woods remain balanced with the fruit. Longevity & Sillage Qaed Al Fursan’s Eau de Parfum base combines fir balsam, oud, cedarwood and amber beneath its pineapple-saffron opening. Fruit is clearest early, while green resins and warm woods are expected to define the later wear. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. results.name: Al Haramain Detour Noir EDP 100ml Unisex
results.description: Al Haramain Detour Noir EDP 100ml is a spiced floral woody fragrance for men and women, and one of the most versatile and broadly appealing fragrances in the Al Haramain range. It sits outside the Amber Oud collection and takes a different approach — a fresh apple and lavender opening, a warm spiced heart of vanilla, patchouli, and mandarin, and a dry, woody base of sandalwood, cardamom, and guaiac wood. The result is a fragrance that is complex without being heavy, and warm without being overtly oriental — a genuine everyday option that works across seasons and occasions. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Apple, jasmine, lavender, violet Heart Notes: Vanilla, bergamot, patchouli, mandarin orange Base Notes: Sandalwood, cardamom, guaiac wood, pepper, geranium Al Haramain Detour Noir EDP opens with apple, jasmine, lavender, and violet — a fresh, slightly floral and fruity opening with a clean, aromatic quality from the lavender. The heart introduces vanilla, bergamot, patchouli, and mandarin orange — a warm, spiced combination that gives the fragrance its depth and complexity. The base settles into sandalwood, cardamom, guaiac wood, pepper, and geranium — warm, woody, and long-lasting, with the cardamom and pepper adding a dry, spiced edge that develops well over several hours. About The Fragrance Al Haramain is a Saudi Arabian fragrance house with decades of experience producing traditional Arabian and contemporary oriental fragrances. Detour Noir is one of their more contemporary offerings — a spiced floral woody that appeals to those who want something with character and complexity without the full weight of a traditional oriental. The fragrance family is spiced floral woody, and it is genuinely unisex in character. Performance & Character Longevity is solid with the sandalwood and guaiac wood base persisting the longest. Projection is moderate, making it comfortable in professional and close-contact environments. The overall character is warm, spiced, and woody — a fragrance that works well in cooler temperatures but is approachable enough for year-round wear. When To Wear Al Haramain Detour Noir EDP 100ml is best suited to autumn and winter, though the fresh lavender and apple opening makes it wearable in spring as well. It works across casual, everyday, and evening settings. It is one of the most seasonally flexible fragrances in the Al Haramain range. Who Is It For? This fragrance suits anyone in their twenties through to fifties who enjoys warm, spiced, woody fragrances with a fresh opening. It is genuinely unisex — the lavender and sandalwood combination works equally well on men and women. It is a strong gifting option given its broad appeal and the accessible price point within the Al Haramain range. results.name: Lattafa Asad EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Asad EDP 100ml is a bold spicy tobacco-amber fragrance for men that opens with black pepper, pineapple and tobacco before moving into coffee, iris and patchouli. Amber, vanilla, dry woods, benzoin and labdanum create a dark, resinous base. Its character is warm, assertive and designed for evening or cool-weather presence. Black pepper establishes immediate spice, pineapple adds a restrained fruity brightness and tobacco brings dry warmth. Coffee deepens the heart, iris adds a smoother powdery texture and patchouli links the centre to the earthy base. Vanilla and benzoin soften the dry woods, while labdanum and amber create a rich resinous finish. Lattafa officially presents Asad as a men’s fragrance. It suits customers who enjoy pepper, tobacco, coffee, dark amber and woody vanilla rather than fresh blue aromatics. The pineapple is a contrast note rather than a tropical theme, and the composition becomes progressively warmer, darker and more balsamic as it settles. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Black pepper, pineapple and tobacco. Heart Notes: Coffee, iris and patchouli. Base Notes: Amber, vanilla, dry woods, benzoin and labdanum. Scent Profile The opening is peppery and dry, with tobacco appearing early while pineapple provides a brief lift. Coffee then adds roasted depth and patchouli contributes earthiness. Iris prevents the heart from feeling rough, introducing a controlled powdery smoothness. In the base, vanilla and benzoin create warmth, labdanum adds dark resin and dry woods maintain structure. Asad develops from peppered tobacco into coffee and iris, finally resting on a dense ambered vanilla-wood foundation. Who Is It For? Best suited to men who enjoy black pepper, tobacco, coffee, patchouli and strong amber-vanilla fragrances. It may appeal to someone wanting a confident cold-weather scent with spice and smoke rather than marine or citrus freshness. Customers sensitive to tobacco, dense resins or sweet woods should begin with a small application. Those seeking a light office fragrance may prefer a fresher profile. When to Wear Particularly suited to autumn, winter, cool evenings, dinners, dates, celebrations, formal events and statement wear. A restrained application can work in a cooler office or evening workplace. In warm or humid weather, use fewer sprays because tobacco, coffee, labdanum, benzoin and vanilla can feel dense as the fragrance heats. Longevity & Sillage Asad’s Eau de Parfum base combines tobacco, patchouli, amber, vanilla, benzoin, labdanum and dry woods beneath its peppered opening. results.name: Lattafa Pride Embrace EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Pride Embrace EDP 100ml is an aromatic resinous fragrance that opens with bergamot, ginger and artemisia before developing through patchouli, fir balsam and incense. Ambergris, benzoin and oakmoss form a deep, textured base. The composition moves from bright spice and herbs into evergreen resins, smoke and a mineral-mossy dry-down. Bergamot gives the opening a clear citrus lift while ginger adds fresh heat. Artemisia introduces a dry herbal bitterness that immediately sets Embrace apart from sweeter amber fragrances. Patchouli brings earthiness through the heart, fir balsam adds green resin and incense creates smoke. Benzoin softens the base as ambergris and oakmoss maintain a dry, sophisticated frame. Lattafa presents Embrace for men and women. It suits customers who enjoy green aromatics, incense, patchouli and chypre-like moss rather than fruit candy or creamy vanilla gourmands. Its contrast between citrus freshness and balsamic depth makes it distinctive, versatile in cool weather and especially rewarding for wearers who appreciate gradual development. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Bergamot, ginger and artemisia. Heart Notes: Patchouli, fir balsam and incense. Base Notes: Ambergris, benzoin and oakmoss. Scent Profile The first spray is fresh, spicy and herbal: bergamot feels bright, ginger is energetic and artemisia gives a bitter green edge. Patchouli soon adds warm earthiness, while fir balsam produces a forest-like resinous quality. Incense creates an airy smoke rather than dense sweetness. In the base, ambergris contributes mineral-amber depth, benzoin offers a smoother balsamic warmth and oakmoss adds dry green texture. Embrace evolves from aromatic brightness into smoky evergreens, finally settling into mossy resinous woods. Who Is It For? A strong choice for any gender when bergamot, ginger, artemisia, fir balsam, incense, patchouli and oakmoss are appealing. It may suit someone looking for a modern aromatic scent with more depth than a conventional fresh fragrance. Customers wanting sweet berries, white-floral creaminess, dessert vanilla or a soft powdery profile should explore another option. Begin with fewer sprays if incense or bitter green notes are unfamiliar. When to Wear Best suited to autumn, winter, spring, cool summer evenings, work, dinners, travel, smart casual occasions and outdoor events. In warm or enclosed conditions, apply lightly so patchouli, smoke and moss remain balanced rather than dense. Citrus and spice are most apparent early, while green resins, smoke and mossy amber are expected to define the later wear. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. Turkish and Bulgarian rose create layered floral depth, while jasmine smooths the transition into the base. Agarwood adds woody darkness, amber provides warmth and vanilla rounds the edges without turning the composition into a conventional gourmand. Presented as unisex, Badee Al Oud Amethyst is aimed at fragrance lovers who enjoy expressive rose, oud and amber rather than delicate, transparent florals. Heart Notes: Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose and jasmine. Base Notes: Agarwood (oud), amber and vanilla. Scent Profile Amethyst begins with a peppered citrus flash that quickly reveals the richness of rose. Turkish rose feels dark and velvety, Bulgarian rose adds floral fullness, and jasmine brings a smoother luminous facet through the middle. Oud anchors the fragrance with woody depth, while amber and vanilla create a warm, rounded dry-down. The result is more floral than Oud for Glory and darker than a typical designer rose perfume. results.name: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime EDP 100ml is a bright fruity-floral fragrance that layers crisp apple, juicy litchi and rose over ripe plum, jasmine, vanilla, moss and patchouli. Compared with the darker oud styles in the Badee Al Oud collection, Sublime feels more colourful, playful and immediately fruit-led. Apple provides a crisp opening while litchi adds watery sweetness and rose brings a soft floral outline. Plum deepens the fruit through the heart, with jasmine adding lift rather than heaviness. Vanilla smooths the base as moss and patchouli contribute an earthy-green contrast that prevents the dry-down from feeling like uncomplicated fruit syrup. Presented as unisex, Sublime suits fragrance lovers who enjoy vivid red-fruit impressions, floral softness and a warm patchouli base. It is approachable for customers exploring Arabian perfumery and versatile enough for everyday wear, social occasions or gifting. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Apple, litchi and rose. Heart Notes: Plum and jasmine. Base Notes: Vanilla, moss and patchouli. Scent Profile Sublime begins juicy and vibrant, led by apple and litchi with rose woven into the fruit rather than sitting separately. Plum makes the middle feel darker and riper, while jasmine supplies a cleaner floral brightness. In the dry-down, vanilla adds softness and patchouli adds warmth, with moss creating a lightly earthy texture. The result is sweet and fruity, but it retains enough floral and green depth to remain balanced. Who Is It For? This fragrance can be worn by anyone who enjoys apple, litchi, plum, rose, vanilla and patchouli. It is a good choice for customers wanting a youthful, expressive fruit-forward scent without the density of oud, smoke or heavy spice. Those who prefer dry woods or low-sweetness citrus fragrances may find Sublime more playful than their usual style. When to Wear Badee Al Oud Sublime works well through spring, autumn and mild New Zealand weather. Consider it for daytime outings, casual dates, brunch, shopping, celebrations, parties and relaxed evening wear. The fruity opening suits social settings, while vanilla, moss and patchouli give it enough depth for cooler evenings. Apply more lightly in heat or enclosed spaces. results.name: Selahatin Whitening Toothpaste - Amorist - 65ml
results.description: A soft and romantic mint inspired by unstained affection and devotion. Amorist gently fuses green mint, peppermint and menthol, resulting in a restrained expression of a true quintessential. Selahatin is introducing the world of artisanal oral care. By converting colours and emotions into whitening toothpaste the brand has the ambition to elevate the experiences of everyday ceremonies. The Stockholm based brand Selahatin has been nominated in Wallpaper Design Awards, been named “one of the best grooming brands in the world” by GQ Magazine and called “the world’s most sophisticated toothpaste brand” by Monocle 1100 ppm fluoride Made in Switzerland Contains antioxidants Housed in alu tubes (recycles endlessly) Contains antioxidants Vetted by The Swedish Dental Association Vegan/Cruelty free Dermatologically tested A four-dimensional rejuvenating whitening process gentle enough for daily use Deep cleansing (Sodium Lauryl Sulphate) Exfoliating (Hydrated Silica) Polishing and light-reflecting (Hydroxypatite) Enamel-bleaching (Sodium Bicarbonate) Anti-inflammatory Limonene from Citrus fruit and antioxidant Edelweiss extract boosts bacterial balance and maintains healthy gums The natural amino acid Betaine moisturises and nourishes Mineralising Hydroxypatite provides proactive care for sensitive teeth Aqua/[water], sorbitol, hydrated silica, ci 77891/[titanium dioxide], sodium lauryl sulfate, betaine, sodium bicarbonate, cellulose gum, peg-12, dicalcium phosphate, parfum/[fragrance], aroma/[flavour], glycerin, sodium fluoride, sodium saccharin, hydroxyapatite, synthetic fluorphlogopite, methylparaben, limonene, potassium chloride, menthol, linalool, leontopodium alpinum extract, tin oxide & eugenol. ABOUT SELAHATIN: The brand was born from a crisis. Before the age of 30, founder Kristoffer Vural had a stroke that left him paralysed and wheelchair-bound. As a result of the injury, his sense of smell was attuned and amplified – taste and scent began to appear as colors in his head. A neurological phenomena known as synesthesia. – I was in recovery and everyday rituals became a way to escape reality. These small ceremonies made a big impact on my wellbeing. When my senses were activated by taste and smell, it was like someone was drawing pictures in my mind. The taste of my toothpastes rendered nothing but grey. I decided to change that, says Kristoffer Vural, founder of Selahatin. The aromas are influenced by founder Kristoffer Vural’s roots. The son of a Swedish mother and a Turkish father, Vural grew up in northern Sweden and spent his summer on the Turkish west coast (the name Selahatin is an hommage to Vural’s Ottoman Empire-born grandfather). The juxtaposition between the Swedish quiet and mild-mannered, and the bold intensity of Istanbul characterises the Selahatin aromas.

results.name: Lattafa Asad Bourbon EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Asad Bourbon EDP 100ml is a spicy aromatic vanilla fragrance that opens with pink pepper, lavender and mirabelle plum before moving into cacao, davana and nutmeg. Bourbon vanilla, amber and vetiver create a warm yet structured base. The composition balances bright spice, herbal freshness, fruit and gourmand depth in a modern unisex style. Pink pepper gives the opening sparkle, lavender adds an aromatic clean edge and mirabelle introduces juicy golden-fruit sweetness. Cacao darkens the heart without turning it into pure chocolate, while nutmeg provides dry warmth and davana contributes a herbal-fruity nuance. Bourbon vanilla and amber soften the base; vetiver adds grounding dryness and contrast. Although some listings positioned Asad Bourbon for men, Lattafa’s official product information presents it for women and men. Its aromatic opening can feel masculine-leaning, but the plum, cacao and vanilla make the wearing style broadly unisex. It suits customers seeking an evening vanilla with spice and character rather than simple sweetness. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Pink pepper, lavender and mirabelle plum. Heart Notes: Cacao, davana and nutmeg. Base Notes: Bourbon vanilla, amber and vetiver. Scent Profile The opening is lively and balanced: lavender feels aromatic, pink pepper is bright and mirabelle adds rounded fruit. Nutmeg brings a dry spicy transition into cacao, while davana creates a nuanced herbaceous warmth. Bourbon vanilla becomes increasingly smooth as the fragrance settles, amber broadens the trail and vetiver keeps the base from becoming syrupy. Asad Bourbon moves from lavender-spiced fruit into cacao and nutmeg, then finishes as a warm, slightly dry vanilla-amber. Who Is It For? A strong choice for any gender when lavender, pink pepper, plum, cacao, nutmeg and bourbon vanilla are appealing. It may suit gourmand lovers who want aromatic freshness and vetiver around the sweetness. Customers looking for marine notes, transparent florals, sharp citrus or a smoky traditional oud should explore another option. Begin with a moderate application in shared indoor settings. When to Wear Best suited to autumn, winter, cool spring evenings, dinners, dates, celebrations, smart casual events and relaxed cold-weather wear. Lavender gives it some daytime versatility, while cacao, vanilla and amber support evening use. In warm or humid conditions, use fewer sprays so the gourmand base stays composed and comfortable. Longevity & Sillage Asad Bourbon’s Eau de Parfum base combines bourbon vanilla, amber and vetiver beneath lavender, spice and cacao. Pink pepper and mirabelle are most evident early, while nutmeg, davana and warm vanilla are expected to shape the later wear. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. Dates introduce a dark honeyed fruitiness through the heart, praline adds roasted sweetness and tuberose brings floral body. Vanilla and tonka bean then merge with amberwood, myrrh, benzoin and dry woods for a long, enveloping finish. The heart becomes richer as dates and praline create a syrupy, caramelised impression, while tuberose and mahonial add floral lift. The base is complex and resinous: vanilla and tonka bean provide creaminess, amberwood and Akigalawood supply woody structure, and myrrh with benzoin adds balsamic warmth. It is sweet, but spice and resins prevent it from feeling one-dimensional. Who Is It For? Khamrah can be worn by anyone who enjoys cinnamon, dates, praline, vanilla, tonka bean and ambered resins. It is particularly appealing to fans of strong gourmands and warm evening fragrances. Customers who prefer very fresh citrus, delicate florals or low-projection office scents should expect a much richer and more enveloping style. When to Wear Khamrah is especially well suited to autumn, winter, cold evenings, dinners, date nights, celebrations, festive occasions and relaxed social events. results.description: Al Haramain L’Aventure EDP 100ml is a bold chypre fruity fragrance for men, and one of the most accessible and versatile fragrances in the Al Haramain range. Where the Amber Oud collection leans into warm oriental territory, L’Aventure takes a completely different direction — a bright citrus opening, a clean woody and jasmine heart, and a warm patchouli and amber base that gives it a confident, masculine character suited to everyday wear. It is a fragrance built for the man who wants something reliable, long-lasting, and broadly appealing without the heaviness of a traditional oriental. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Lemon, bergamot, elemi Heart Notes: Woody notes, jasmine, lily of the valley Base Notes: Musk, patchouli, amber Al Haramain L’Aventure EDP opens with lemon, bergamot, and elemi — a bright, citrus-forward opening with a resinous edge from the elemi. The heart introduces woody notes, jasmine, and lily of the valley — a clean, slightly floral woody combination that gives the fragrance its masculine character. The base settles into musk, patchouli, and amber — warm, earthy, and long-lasting, with the patchouli giving it a grounded, confident finish. About The Fragrance Al Haramain is a Saudi Arabian fragrance house with decades of experience producing traditional Arabian and contemporary oriental fragrances. L’Aventure is one of their most internationally recognised fragrances — a chypre fruity masculine that sits outside the Amber Oud collection and appeals to a broader audience. The fragrance family is chypre fruity, and it is widely noted as a strong value alternative to Creed Aventus, sharing a similar citrus and patchouli structure at a fraction of the price. Performance & Character Longevity is solid with the patchouli and amber base persisting the longest. Projection is moderate to noticeable on initial application, settling to a closer sillage after the first couple of hours. The overall character is fresh, clean, and confident — a fragrance that works across a wide range of settings and seasons. The bright citrus opening makes it appropriate for daytime, work, and casual occasions, while the warm patchouli base gives it enough depth for evenings. results.name: Lattafa His Confession EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa His Confession EDP 100ml is a warm aromatic-amber fragrance where mandarin, cinnamon and lavender lead into powdery iris, cypress and benzoin over vanilla, tonka bean, patchouli, cedarwood, incense and amber. It balances fresh aromatic lift with a smooth, resinous and confidently masculine dry-down. Mandarin brightens the opening while cinnamon adds warmth and lavender creates a familiar aromatic frame. Iris gives the heart a refined powdery texture, contrasted by the clean woody character of cypress. Benzoin connects that centre to a deeper base of vanilla, tonka, incense, amber, patchouli and cedarwood. Presented for men, His Confession suits customers who enjoy sophisticated powdery scents, warm spice and evening-ready amber depth. It is richer than a fresh everyday aromatic but smoother and more polished than a heavily smoky oud fragrance. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Mandarin, cinnamon and lavender. Heart Notes: Iris, cypress, benzoin and mahonial. Base Notes: Vanilla, tonka bean, patchouli, cedarwood, incense and amber. Scent Profile His Confession opens aromatic and gently spiced, with mandarin preventing the lavender and cinnamon from feeling too dense. Iris becomes the signature through the heart, creating a soft powdery elegance, while cypress adds vertical woody freshness. Benzoin introduces resinous sweetness before vanilla, tonka bean, amber and incense deepen the base. Patchouli and cedarwood keep the finish structured and masculine. Who Is It For? This fragrance is best suited to men who enjoy iris, lavender, cinnamon, vanilla, tonka bean, amber and incense. It works for someone seeking a distinctive evening or smart-casual scent with a powdery centre and warm finish. Customers who prefer crisp marine fragrances or very light citrus colognes may find it more substantial than their daily style. When to Wear His Confession is particularly well suited to autumn, winter, cool spring evenings, date nights, dinners, formal occasions, celebrations and dressed-up social events. A light application can work for daytime in cooler weather, while the vanilla-incense base naturally suits evenings. Use restraint in warm indoor spaces. results.name: Zimaya Sharaf Blend 100ml Extrait de Parfum Unisex
results.description: Zimaya Sharaf Blend Extrait de Parfum 100ml is a rich oud oriental fragrance for men and women, produced by Zimaya — a premium sub-brand of Afnan. At Extrait de Parfum concentration, it delivers exceptional longevity and a dry-down that continues to develop for many hours. The character is warm, sweet, and deeply Arabian — saffron and oud at its core, with dates adding an unusual sweetness in the heart and a creamy vanilla and sandalwood base that makes it more approachable than a pure oud fragrance. It is built for those who want an authentic Arabian fragrance experience with maximum staying power. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Saffron, bergamot, cardamom Heart Notes: Oud, rose, dates Base Notes: Vanilla, amber, musk, sandalwood Zimaya Sharaf Blend Extrait opens with saffron, bergamot, and cardamom — a warm, golden opening where the saffron immediately sets the tone. The heart introduces oud, rose, and dates — a rich, sweet, and distinctly Arabian combination that gives the fragrance its defining character. The dates add an unusual sweetness that softens the oud and makes the heart more accessible than many pure oud fragrances. The base settles into vanilla, amber, musk, and sandalwood — creamy, warm, and exceptionally long-lasting. About The Fragrance Zimaya is a premium sub-brand of Afnan, positioned above the main Afnan line in terms of ingredient quality and complexity. The Sharaf Blend reflects the brand’s Arabian heritage directly — saffron, oud, and dates are all central to traditional Middle Eastern perfumery and culture. The use of dates in the heart is particularly distinctive and gives the Sharaf Blend a character that is harder to find in Western fragrance. The fragrance family is oud oriental. Performance & Character At Extrait de Parfum concentration, longevity is exceptional — expect twelve or more hours on skin, with the oud and vanilla base persisting well into the following day on clothing. Projection is strong on initial application, settling to a moderate sillage after the first hour. One spray is often sufficient. The overall character is rich, warm, and sweet — more approachable than a pure oud fragrance due to the dates and vanilla, but still a serious evening fragrance that rewards restraint in application. When To Wear Zimaya Sharaf Blend Extrait 100ml is an autumn and winter evening fragrance. The saffron, oud, and dates combination makes it best suited to special occasions, formal dinners, and evenings where a bold, lasting fragrance is appropriate. It is not suited to daytime professional environments or warm weather. Who Is It For? This fragrance suits confident wearers in their mid-twenties and older who appreciate Arabian-style perfumery and want something with genuine depth and longevity. It is genuinely unisex — the oud and rose combination works on both men and women, and the dates and vanilla base softens it enough to be wearable by those who are new to oud fragrances. It is one of the strongest gifting options in the Afnan/Zimaya catalogue for someone who appreciates traditional Middle Eastern fragrance culture. It suits customers who are curious about oud but prefer it framed by fruit, florals, vanilla and amber resins. Vanilla and tonka bean reinforce comfort, amber broadens the trail and oud provides woody gravity. The dry-down is therefore an amber-vanilla oud rather than a dry, smoky or aggressively animalic oud style. Who Is It For? A strong fit for any gender when plum, heliotrope, vanilla, amber resins and approachable oud are preferred. results.name: Lattafa Pride Sehr EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Pride Sehr EDP 100ml is a warm spicy almond-vanilla fragrance that opens with cinnamon and bitter almond before revealing jasmine, Pomarose and Akigalawood. Vanilla absolute, amber and tonka bean create a plush base. The result is sweet and enveloping, but its woody spice and slightly bitter opening give the gourmand warmth a more composed edge. Cinnamon provides immediate heat while bitter almond adds a nutty, marzipan-like quality with a darker tone. Jasmine lifts the heart; Pomarose contributes a rosy fruit effect and Akigalawood brings peppery patchouli-like wood. Vanilla absolute and tonka then soften the structure, while amber broadens the scent into a warm, smooth trail. Sehr is presented for everyone and suits customers who enjoy almond, cinnamon and vanilla but want more than a simple dessert accord. Its floral-fruity heart and spicy wood create movement between the nutty opening and ambered base. It feels particularly at home in cool weather, at evening events and whenever a comforting but noticeable fragrance is preferred. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Cinnamon and bitter almond. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Pomarose and Akigalawood. Base Notes: Vanilla absolute, amber and tonka bean. Scent Profile The first impression is a clear blend of cinnamon and bitter almond, combining dry spice with nutty sweetness. Jasmine prevents the centre from feeling too dense, while Pomarose introduces a rosy apple-like fruitiness. Akigalawood contributes a modern spicy-woody texture that helps bridge the heart and base. Vanilla absolute becomes richer as the fragrance warms, tonka bean adds almond-like creaminess and amber creates glow. Sehr develops from spiced marzipan into floral woods, then a deep vanilla-amber finish. Who Is It For? A strong option for any gender when bitter almond, cinnamon, vanilla, tonka and warm amber are favourites. It may appeal to gourmand lovers who want spice and woods around the sweetness. Customers seeking citrus freshness, marine notes, transparent clean musk or a very dry leather fragrance should explore another style. Begin with a lighter application if almond, cinnamon or vanilla tends to project strongly on your skin. When to Wear Best suited to autumn, winter, cool spring evenings, dinners, date nights, celebrations, festive occasions and relaxed cold-weather wear. A restrained application can work in an office or indoor social setting. In warm or humid weather, use fewer sprays because cinnamon, vanilla absolute, tonka and amber can become dense as the fragrance heats. Longevity & Sillage Sehr’s Eau de Parfum base uses vanilla absolute, amber and tonka bean beneath cinnamon, almond and Akigalawood, supporting a warm dry-down after the brighter floral heart. Spice and bitter almond are most recognisable early, while woody vanilla-amber defines the later wear. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. results.name: Lattafa Pride Al Areeq Gold EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Pride Al Areeq Gold EDP 100ml is a warm leather-amber fragrance in which saffron and black tea lead into incense, suede and a deeper leather accord. Vanilla, musk and amberwood round the base without erasing its smoky character. The composition feels dark, tactile and polished, balancing spice, tea dryness and supple warmth for a confident unisex profile. Saffron opens with a dry, leathery spice while black tea adds aromatic bitterness and depth. Incense then creates a smoky veil through the heart, where suede gives a smoother texture beside the firmer leather note. As the fragrance settles, amberwood supports projection and structure; vanilla and musk soften the edges and make the finish more wearable. Al Areeq Gold suits customers who enjoy leather fragrances but prefer warmth and resinous softness around the main accord. It is neither a bright fresh scent nor a dessert-like vanilla. Instead, its appeal lies in the contrast between black tea, incense, suede and a gently sweet base, making it a strong option for evenings and cooler conditions. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Saffron and black tea. Heart Notes: Incense, suede and leather. Base Notes: Amberwood, vanilla and musk. Scent Profile The opening is aromatic and dry, with saffron amplifying the natural leather association of black tea. Incense adds smoke and resin without turning the composition into a heavy oud fragrance. Suede becomes the softer face of the heart, while leather provides darker structure. Amberwood gives the base a modern woody lift; vanilla adds controlled sweetness and musk smooths the trail. The result moves from spiced tea to smoky leather, then settles into a warm, softly musky amber. Who Is It For? A good choice for any gender when leather, saffron, black tea, incense and warm amber are preferred. It may suit someone who finds stark leather perfumes too severe but still wants more character than a simple vanilla. Customers looking for citrus freshness, tropical fruit or an airy floral profile should explore another fragrance. Start lightly if saffron, smoke or leather tends to project strongly on your skin. When to Wear Best in autumn, winter, cool spring evenings, dinners, date nights, formal occasions and smart evening wear. It can become a distinctive personal signature in cooler New Zealand conditions. For office or daytime use, keep the application restrained. Heat intensifies saffron, leather and amberwood, so fewer sprays are advisable during humid weather or close indoor events. Longevity & Sillage Al Areeq Gold’s Eau de Parfum structure uses leather, incense, amberwood, vanilla and musk to support the dry-down after its saffron and tea opening. Suede and smoke are likely to remain apparent as the base becomes warmer and smoother. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. results.name: Lattafa Pride Al Qiam Gold EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Pride Al Qiam Gold EDP 100ml is a fruity leather-oud fragrance that opens with vivid raspberry and saffron before moving into patchouli, leather and a deep ambered wood base. The fruit brings brightness, but the structure is dark and substantial: oud, guaiac wood, vetiver and benzoin create smoke, dryness and resinous warmth beneath the opening. Raspberry gives the first spray a tart, juicy accent while saffron contributes spice and a familiar leathery nuance. Patchouli links that fruit to the heart’s leather accord, adding earthiness and depth. Amber and benzoin supply warmth in the dry-down; oud and guaiac wood bring dark wood and smoke, while vetiver keeps the base from becoming overly sweet. Lattafa presents Al Qiam Gold for women and men. It is a strong option for customers who like fruit used as contrast within a darker leather composition rather than as the whole story. Its raspberry-saffron opening is immediately expressive, while the woody base gives it enough gravity for evening wear, cooler weather and more formal settings. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Saffron and raspberry. Heart Notes: Patchouli and leather. Base Notes: Amber, oud, guaiac wood, vetiver and benzoin. Scent Profile The opening balances tart raspberry against saffron’s dry spice. As the fruit softens, patchouli creates an earthy transition into leather, making the scent progressively darker. Amber and benzoin round the base with resinous sweetness, but vetiver introduces dryness and oud adds density. Guaiac wood contributes a smoky, slightly charred texture. Al Qiam Gold therefore shifts from colourful fruit and spice to leather, earth and warm woods, retaining only a trace of raspberry later in the wear. Who Is It For? Suited to any gender when raspberry, saffron, leather, patchouli and oud are appealing. It may be a useful bridge for someone moving from fruity amber fragrances into deeper leather and woody styles. It is less suitable for customers seeking a light citrus cologne, marine freshness or a clean floral musk. When to Wear Especially appropriate for autumn, winter, cool evenings, dinners, celebrations, date nights and formal or dressed-up occasions. In hot or humid weather, reduce the spray count because saffron, oud, amber and benzoin can feel denser as temperatures rise. Longevity & Sillage As an Eau de Parfum with patchouli, leather, amber, oud, guaiac wood, vetiver and benzoin, Al Qiam Gold has a substantial base beneath its brighter raspberry opening. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. results.name: Lattafa Niche Emarati Mughal Fort EDP 100ml
results.description: Lattafa Niche Emarati Mughal Fort EDP 100ml is a spicy gourmand-amber fragrance built around cardamom, pimento, caramel and cedarwood over vanilla, musk and amber. It combines edible warmth with a dry woody frame, so the composition feels comforting without losing structure. The effect is rich, enveloping and well suited to cooler weather and evening wear. Cardamom gives the opening a cool, aromatic spice while pimento adds a warmer peppery facet. Cedarwood arrives through the heart to balance caramel’s toasted sweetness. Vanilla continues the gourmand character in the base, but amber and musk add warmth, diffusion and smoothness, creating a rounded dry-down rather than a simple caramel dessert accord. Mughal Fort is presented as unisex and will appeal to people who enjoy sweet spice, vanilla and amber with a clear woody backbone. Its compact note list gives each accord room to register. It feels more gourmand than a classic woody fragrance, yet cardamom, pimento and cedar keep the sweetness from becoming entirely soft or creamy. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Cardamom and pimento. Heart Notes: Cedarwood and caramel. Base Notes: Vanilla, musk and amber. Scent Profile The opening is aromatic and spicy: cardamom feels cool and slightly green, while pimento introduces dry heat. Caramel soon adds a toasted sugar impression, softened but also structured by cedarwood. As the fragrance settles, vanilla reinforces the warmth and musk smooths the edges. Amber creates a glowing resinous effect that ties the spice and gourmand notes together. The result develops from spiced woods to caramel warmth and finally a soft, musky vanilla-amber trail. Who Is It For? A good option for any gender when cardamom, caramel, vanilla, amber and warm woods are favourites. It may suit someone seeking a cold-weather gourmand that remains more structured than a purely sugary perfume. Customers wanting bright citrus, watery freshness, delicate florals or dry smoke may prefer a different style. Begin lightly in enclosed spaces because caramel, vanilla and amber can feel fuller as they warm. When to Wear Best suited to autumn, winter, cool evenings, dinners, dates, relaxed celebrations and cosy weekend wear. It can work as a distinctive signature during colder New Zealand conditions. Use a restrained application for work or close indoor settings; in cool outdoor air, a moderate spray count allows the spice, cedar and amber to unfold. Longevity & Sillage Mughal Fort’s Eau de Parfum base combines cedarwood, caramel, vanilla, musk and amber, giving the composition a warm foundation after its cardamom-pimento opening. Spice is clearest early, while caramelised woods and musky amber define the later wear. Actual longevity and sillage vary with skin chemistry, application, temperature, clothing and storage. results.name: Al Haramain Amber Oud Ruby Edition EDP 120ml Unisex
results.description: Al Haramain Amber Oud Ruby Edition EDP 120ml is a warm woody unisex fragrance from Al Haramain, one of Saudi Arabia’s most established fragrance houses. The Ruby Edition sits within the Amber Oud collection — a range of oriental fragrances built around the combination of amber and oud — and takes a softer, more floral direction than some of the darker entries in the range. The saffron and jasmine combination gives it a warm, slightly exotic character that works well across genders and is suited to cooler months and evening occasions. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Saffron, bitter almond Heart Notes: Egyptian jasmine, cedar Base Notes: Ambergris, woody notes, musk Al Haramain Amber Oud Ruby Edition EDP opens with saffron and bitter almond — a warm, slightly sweet and exotic opening that is immediately distinctive. The heart introduces Egyptian jasmine and cedar, adding a soft floral warmth with a dry, spiced edge. The base settles into ambergris, woody notes, and musk — smooth, warm, and long-lasting, with the ambergris giving it a distinctive salty-sweet depth that develops well over several hours. About The Fragrance Al Haramain is a Saudi Arabian fragrance house with decades of experience producing traditional Arabian and contemporary oriental fragrances. The Amber Oud collection is one of their most recognised ranges internationally, known for producing high-quality oriental fragrances at accessible price points. The Ruby Edition was designed as a warm, floral-oriental entry in the range — the saffron and jasmine combination gives it a character that is more approachable than the darker, smokier entries. The fragrance family is woody floral oriental. Performance & Character Longevity is solid with the ambergris and musk base persisting the longest. Projection is moderate on initial application, settling to a closer sillage after the first couple of hours. The overall character is warm, smooth, and slightly floral — a fragrance that works well in cooler temperatures and evening settings without being overwhelming. When To Wear Al Haramain Amber Oud Ruby Edition EDP 120ml is best suited to autumn and winter. The warm saffron and ambergris character makes it a natural fit for evenings, casual occasions, and cooler-weather wear. It is less suited to daytime professional environments or warm weather, where a lighter fragrance would be more appropriate. Who Is It For? This fragrance suits anyone in their twenties through to fifties who enjoys warm, smooth, oriental-leaning fragrances. It is genuinely unisex — the saffron and jasmine combination works equally well on men and women. results.description: Al Haramain Amber Oud Rouge EDP 120ml is a sweet oriental unisex fragrance launched in 2015, and one of the most talked-about entries in the Al Haramain Amber Oud collection. It is widely noted for its similarity to Maison Francis Kurkdjian’s Baccarat Rouge 540 — sharing the same saffron, amberwood, and cedarwood structure — making it one of the most accessible alternatives to that fragrance available in New Zealand. The character is warm, sweet, and resinous, with a smooth amberwood heart that is immediately recognisable to fans of the Baccarat Rouge style. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Saffron, jasmine Heart Notes: Amberwood, ambergris Base Notes: Fir resin, cedarwood Al Haramain Amber Oud Rouge EDP opens with saffron and jasmine — an exotic, slightly floral opening with a warm golden quality from the saffron. The heart introduces amberwood and ambergris, adding a rich, resinous sweetness with a salty-smooth depth that is the defining character of the fragrance. The base settles into fir resin and cedarwood — dry, woody, and slightly earthy, grounding the sweetness of the amber and giving the fragrance a lasting, complex finish. About The Fragrance Al Haramain is a Saudi Arabian fragrance house with decades of experience producing traditional Arabian and contemporary oriental fragrances. Amber Oud Rouge was launched in 2015 and quickly gained recognition internationally as a high-quality alternative to Baccarat Rouge 540, sharing its core amberwood and saffron structure at a fraction of the price. The fragrance family is sweet oriental woody, and it remains one of the most popular fragrances in the Al Haramain catalogue. Performance & Character Longevity is strong with the amberwood and fir resin base persisting the longest. Projection is moderate to noticeable on initial application, settling to a closer sillage after the first couple of hours. The overall character is warm, sweet, and smooth — a fragrance that is immediately recognisable and broadly appealing. It performs best in cooler temperatures; in summer heat, the sweetness can become more prominent than intended. When To Wear Al Haramain Amber Oud Rouge EDP 120ml is best suited to autumn and winter evenings. The warm, sweet oriental character makes it a natural fit for dinners, events, and special occasions. It is less suited to daytime professional environments or warm weather, where a lighter fragrance would be more appropriate. Who Is It For? This fragrance suits anyone in their twenties through to fifties who enjoys warm, sweet, oriental fragrances. It is genuinely unisex — the saffron and amberwood combination works equally well on men and women. It is particularly well suited to those who enjoy Baccarat Rouge 540 but want a more accessible option, and is one of the strongest value propositions in the Al Haramain range available in New Zealand. results.name: CARVEN Ma Griffe 100ml EDP
results.description: The couture legacy, the unabashed femininity, the modernity despite its 70 years, the refinement of a superb chypre harmony, and, finally, simplicity, the signature of the House of Carven. Mrs Carven created in 1946 a fresh, dashing, very flowery fragrance while remaining classic with a touch of haute couture. Its name imposed itself quite naturally. It would bear the name of Madame Carven's signature dress of simple green and white striped cotton: Ma Griffe. A legendary fragrance inspired by Madame Carven's favourite flowers: Gardenia, Jasmine and Rose. Carven puts the glorious chypre fragrance born in 1946 back in centre stage, 70 years after its creation without touching its original formula. The top notes are a burst of freshness: Bergamot, Lemon, Gardenia Bud. The heart is a profusion of Jasmine against notes of Sandalwood, Rose and Ylang Ylang. In the base is a masculine note built around Vetiver, Musk, Tonka Bean and Styrax. It is a fragrance of happiness with a terribly elegant trail. The Parisian fashion house founded in 1945 by Marie-Louise Carven was focused primarily on creating couture before venturing into ready-to-wear in 1950. Today, Carven offers a chic, accessible take on French style with luxury apparel, fragrance, and bath and body care.

results.name: Paradigme by Prada 50ml EDP for Men
results.description: Paradigme by Prada 50ml Eau De Parfum Spray for Men Paradigme, the new signature masculine fragrance by Prada. A fragrance that transcends traditional preconceptions by asking "What if there's another way?" A question as an invitation to experiment and open new perspectives. Paradigme Eau de Parfum expresses sophistication and avant-garde in an unexpected masculine ambery woody scent, a long-lasting fragrance with captivating projection. Designer: Prada Year Introduced: 2025 Type: EDP Category: Men Fragrance Notes: Paradigme Eau de Parfum rethinks the traditional way to create a fragrance. Our master perfumers Marie Salamagne, Bruno Jovanovic, and Nicolas Bonneville decided to open a new olfactive paradigm by inverting the traditional fragrance composition architecture, tracing from the bottom up in a reversed pyramid; a symbolic echo of the iconic Prada triangle itself. The result is an avant-garde yet highly sophisticated Ambery Woody signature oscillating between enveloping warmth and exhilarating freshness. Opening on the warm sensuality of ambery woods composed of Peru Balm and Benzoin resin and vigorous Guaiac wood. results.name: ROBERT PIGUET BANDIT 100ml
results.description: Eau de Parfum Bandit was Robert Piguet's debut fragrance in 1944 and was the first chypre fragrance to incorporate smokey and leathery tones. Notes Top notes of galbanum and ylang-ylang. Heart notes of leather and jasmine. Base notes of patchouli, oak moss and vetiver. Scent Type Dry Woods History In 1944, Robert Piguet created a daring couture collection, which was based on a “Bad Boy” concept. Just at the end of the second World War, Piguet’s shows featured models sporting villain masks and brandishing toy revolvers and swords. The scent accompanying this air of avant-garde mischief was Bandit, a composition created by perfume icon, Germaine Cellier, renowned for her bold and distinctive creations. Bandit is a renowned classic. Cellier used dark notes of leather, the greenness of moss and smoky woods, to give the scent its rich and unforgettable character. Accented with verdant galbanum and hints of orange-blossom, Bandit is certainly the “enfant terrible” of the Piguet fragrance collection. Jasmine and patchouli lend an exotic twist while leather and oak moss provide a thorny crown. Bandit is a fragrance composition light years ahead of its time — a perfumer’s perfume. “Robert Piguet taught me the virtues of simplicity through which true elegance must come,” wrote Christian Dior who years earlier, was a penniless artist who would eventually become one of Piguet’s most celebrated “stagiares”. Other names that trained at The House of Piguet read like a Who’s Who of haute couture including Hubert de Givenchy, Marc Bohan, Pierre Balmain, and John Galanos. But while Piguet’s impact on fashion is indisputable, it is his fragrance legacy that has made him legendary. Working with perfumer Germaine Cellier in the late ‘40s, it was Piguet’s Bandit and Fracas that acted as the watershed to a new era in perfumery. These were said to “have a particular feel very characteristic of his trademarks: Strict adherence to good taste, true luxury, a horror of the commonplace and an innate sense of seduction.”

results.name: Giorgio Armani My Way Sunny Vanilla EDP 90ml
results.description: A delicious floral fruity fragrance that opens with a bright Pineapple accord. Lending a solar, floral sensuality to the heart is Tuberose Heart – one of the elegant signatures of My Way - while a Jasmine Grandiflorum Superinfusion captures a radiant freshness. The soft, sunny warmth of a Vanilla Infusion emerges at the base. My Way Sunny Vanilla’s signature ingredients contain natural and sustainably sourced jasmine and vanilla. From Madagascar’s Sava region , the Vanilla Infusion is both crafted for Giorgio Armani and sustainably sourced , as part of the brand's solidarity sourcing program with NGO Fanamby. This program is supported by Giorgio Armani to protect the environment and empower the local community . The vanilla extract is obtained from hand-pollinated vanilla pods that are steamed and dried, before being treated at a precise temperature and pressure, to conjure the exact scent of the raw vanilla pod. A final step of gently heating the vanilla extract creates its powerful concentration and intensely warm, balsamic tones.

results.name: ARQUISTE A GROVE BY THE SEA 100ml
results.description: A GROVE BY THE SEA Adriatic Aromatic Picture a sunny island in the Adriatic, a small harbour with stone houses and fig and olive groves, surrounded by verdant hills of Mediterranean pine tree, strings of cypress and wild herbs throughout. A window into an evergreen, aromatic landscape of Adriatic fig, dried pine needles, wild rosemary, thyme and the subtle, nutty scent of olive oil. A green and aromatic fig fragrance transporting you to the aromatic island of Lopud, Croatia. History August 1508, Lopud Island, Adriatic Sea Lopud is an evergreen island with lush fig and olive groves by the sea. From the port, dotted with Renaissance stone villas, the scent of fig and crushed olives is so strong that the salty sea breeze carries it beyond, towards forests of Mediterranean pine and cypress. Above, ancient chapels overlooking the harbour like sentinels are overgrown with wild thyme, fennel and rosemary. The whole landscape an aromatic paradise of green fig, dried pine needles, wild herbs and the subtle, nutty scent of olive oil. Developed with Rodrigo Flores Roux. TOP NOTES Adriatic fig leaves Black olive Fleur de sel accord Croatian clementine HEART NOTES Extra virgin olive oil accord Ripe fig fruit Thyme essence Rosemary essence BASE NOTES Mediterranean pine needle Fir balsam Mediterranean cypress Red clay =============================================== More research - Lopud, one of the three main islands in the Elaphiti archipelago, a 45-minute boat ride from Dubrovnik. Called Isola di Mezzo back when Dubrovnik was the Republic of Ragusa, Lopud sits between Šipan and Koločep, two other evergreen islands. Covered in pine, cypress, overgrown olive groves and fruit orchards, they’re dotted with abandoned Medieval and Renaissance-era stone villas and farms that provided the sustenance for the prosperous old Republic. Lopud suffered an earthquake in the 17th century that left it largely abandoned and untouched until the 20th century. Since then, day trippers come to enjoy quiet, clear waters and perfect sand at Sunj bay, then leave the island to the locals and a small community of expats who have restored the old stone houses along a hill near the Franciscan monastery, once the centre of life on the island. - Purchased by the Republic of Dubrovnik in the 11th century, Lopud became a seat for the republic’s governor in 1459 and many noble families built summer estates here. By the 17th century, 14,000 people were living on Lopud where the shipping industry and sea trade was flourishing. Sadly when the earthquake of 1667 hit, the island was never again able to attain its former glory and today less than 300 people live on the island. - The Franciscan Monastery was founded in 1483 on the east side of the island overlooking Lopud bay. By the end of the Croatian War of Independence in 1995, the site was home to a functioning church amidst ruined buildings, former gardens, an unused fortress, and vacant land. Earthquakes, fire, and abandonment had undermined the site's survival, weakening the walls and encouraging rampant vegetation growth. - For a long time Lopud was known as the island of "Sea Captains", the birthplace of the most famous seafarers in the Dubrovnik Republic. In the past, it was the summer residence of ancient aristocracy and today you can still admire these ancient fortifications and medieval churches, a visible sign of the historical importance of the island.

results.description: Aleksandr - Amber - Leather - Woody - Eau de Parfum January 1837, St. Petersburg, Russia. On a frosty winter afternoon, a fiery gentleman finishes his toilette by dabbing on a preparation of Neroli and Violet. He draws down his cuffs, dons a heavy fur and strides out in polished leather boots. As he rides off on his sledge, the woody scent of Fir fills the air. results.name: ARQUISTE ALMOND SUEDE 100ml
results.description: ALMOND SUEDE Marzipan & Leather An addictive and sophisticated unisex gourmand balancing almond marzipan and suede leather inspired by Medieval Andalusia, the city of Córdoba and almond sweets. A must try for gourmand lovers. Top Notes Pink peppercorn, Italian bergamot oil, Honeycomb absolute, Bitter almond oil Heart Notes Cistus concrete from Spain ORPUR, North African neroli oil ORPUR, Saffron accord, Orange flower accord Base Notes Candied sugar, Vanilla absolute, Pine tar from France ORPUR, Suede accord Developed with Calice Becker. ============================== History December 810, Córdoba, Al-Andalus / Sefarad, Spain. In the golden age of Al-Andalus, confectioners crafted almond marzipan of unparalleled delicacy. The secret lay in the whispered exchange between Moorish and Spanish kitchens, transforming recipes of almond flour, sugar, saffron and orange blossom into an art. Nearby, within the vibrant streets of Córdoba, skilled artisans shaped leather into exquisite wonders. Thus, the velvety scent of marzipan commingled with the oaky Córdoba leather, their crafts a symbolic bridge between cultures and traditions, proving that even in the crucible of diverse rule, the sweetest symphonies could emerge from shared traditions. =============================== Further Research During the Al-Andalus period, Córdoba, Spain was known for its many crafts, including leather goods, gold and silverwork, textiles, glass mosaics that decorate The Great Umayyad Mosque of Córdoba, and delectable dishes of Arabic and North-African influence using local Iberian ingredients. - Cordoba leather, also called guadamecies are leather pieces that are embossed, modeled, and colored with modern or classical designs. Cordoban leather has been made since medieval times to decorate chests, trunks, screens, cases, books, luxury shoes, and gloves and was traditionally gilt and thin enough to be embossed. This type of craft came from a technique mastered by the city of Ghadames in Libya (hence the name guadamacies), which had made it its specialty for a long time, and which was imported by the Moors under the Caliphate of Cordoba. - Marzipan's geographical origin has been debated. Thought to have originated in Persia and introduced into Europe via the Turks, another possible geographic origin is Medieval Spain, part of which was then under Muslim control, known as Al-Andalus. Marzipan became an art form there, made possible by the Arab introduction of sugar to the Iberian Peninsula, combined with almond trees so plentiful that the Andalusian hills looked as if they were covered in snow when they bloomed. - The three main religious groups in Al-Andalus, or Moorish Spain, were Muslisms, Christians and Jews, who coexisted for over seven centuries. Their interactions led to the creation of a unique culture expressed in the arts, craft and philosophy.

results.name: ARQUISTE INDIGO SMOKE 100ml
results.description: Evoking the traditional smoking of tea leaves in ancient China, Indigo Smoke is an aromatic landscape of narrow serpentine rivers, blue mountains and incense-filled temples condensed into a complex formula of black tea, woody notes and incense. Rich, sophisticated and long-lasting. With notes of lapsang souchong tea, mandarin orange, apricot, guaiac wood, incense and pine tar. 100 ml / 3.4 fl oz. Eau de Parfum History May 1646, Wuyi Mountains, Fujian. For centuries, diligent monks in the Wuyi Mountains have grown tea and indigo plants in neatly terraced plantations. In 1646, their monasteries were attacked by Qing soldiers from the north. As the monks were forced to flee, they smoked batches of tea leaves over pinewood fire to preserve their crops. This would become the smoky lapsang souchong tea. Mixing with the fresh mountain air and the incense from nearby shrines, the intoxicating plumes of indigo smoke captured the colours of the Wuyi Mountains and their dramatic river narrows. Developed with Calice Becker. TOP NOTES Bergamot Mandarin orange oil Lapsang souchong accord Vetiver HEART NOTES Apricot accord Cassia oil Carrot seed oil Gaiac wood BASE NOTES Maté tea absolute Cedar leaf oil Pine tar Incense Description Created with master perfume Calice Becker, Indigo Smoke is a fragrance for every gender, inspired by the aromatic history of lapsang souchong tea. Like the mountain terraces from which it originated, it encapsulates an aromatic landscape of indigo blues, purples and greens. Eau de Parfum. Large 100 ml / 3.4 fl oz. bottle of the highest Italian quality with the signature ‘A’ engraved metal cap, as well as the newest technology for an invisible spray tube. More research - Lapsang souchong was first created in 1646, as civilians in the Wuyi Mountain areas fled from Qing soldiers who were advancing through the area on their Manchu unification campaign against the Southern Ming. Before they fled, to avoid spoilage of newly plucked leaves, batches were quickly dried over fire and buried in sacks. Afterwards, despite the odor, the tea leaves were shipped and sold to the Dutch traders. At the time, the months-long journey from China to Europe necessitated preservation methods and the partial oxidation of this Wuyi tea was better able to preserve its quality. The smoky souchong tea sold and the Dutch returned to request more. Lapsang Souchong was perhaps the first black tea ever produced and traded.The trade name would later become lapsang souchong from the Fuzhou dialect: La (pine) Sang (wood) with souchong meaning "small sort" referring to the leaves used. - In the 16th century, farmers in Wuyi began growing tea and indigo side by side on the mountainside, on estates owned by Buddhist or Taoist monasteries. The farmers cut terraces into the slopes, and built a system of dikes and drains. During the Ming dynasty, monks also developed a new technique for stopping the oxidation process of tea, pan-firing the leaves in a dry wok rather than steaming them as had been done previously. This produced a darker, more fragrant type of tea. - Lapsang souchong is manufactured similar to black tea but with an intermediary step of smoking. Traditionally pine wood is used for this, and the leaves are processed within a smoke house. The indoor withering is done with the leaves laid out on bamboo mats and turned and rolling at intervals. Many of the compounds making up its wood-smoked aroma, originate in the pine smoke and are not found in other kinds of tea. - The Wuyi Mountains are the largest and most representative example of Chinese subtropical forests, including warm coniferous, evergreen and bamboo forests. The landscape is characterised by beautiful winding river valleys flanked by dramatic columnar or dome-shaped cliffs.

results.name: ARQUISTE L'OR DE LOUIS 100ml
results.description: An opulent, woody orange blossom composition including 24 karat gold. April 1687, The Orangery, Versailles. More than a thousand Mediterranean trees are housed in the cathedral-like galleries of the Orangery. Built by the King’s architect to impress courtiers, the tree-lined space became a theatrical setting to entertain the Court. Inside, the gardeners would build bonfires to keep the trees warm so when the Sun King visited, the heady scent of firewood blended with his beloved orange blossoms would emit a generous golden aura. Notes include: Orange blossom absolute, pomegranate, cedar wood, honey, jasmine absolute, Florentine orris, musk accord, firewood smoke accord, cade wood and a ‘Oiselet de Chypre’ accord. Developed with master perfumer Rodrigo Flores-Roux. More Research - Louis XIV was dubbed the ‘sweetest smelling monarch’. To satisfy his love of orange blossom he imported thousands of orange trees from Italy, Portugal and Spain and had his architect Jules Hardouin-Mansart expand the largest ever Orangery in Europe. During his reign, it was fashionable among nobles, to pay their court, to offer their own citrus and fruit trees to complement the King’s collection. - A true genius of architecture, the name of Hardouin-Mansart is attached to the most grandiose achievements of the reign of Louis XIV. At Versailles, he designed among others the Hall of Mirrors, the North and South wings, the Cent-Marches staircases, the Royal Chapel, the Grand Trianon and of course the Orangery. - The Orangery, by its monumentality and the purity of its lines, is one of the places where Hardouin- Mansart best asserted his talent as a great architect. Orange trees from Portugal, Spain or Italy, lemon trees, oleanders, palm trees and even pomegranate trees, have been protected for over 200 years within its monumental galleries. - In fact, the Palace of Versailles has had an orangery since 1663, built by Louis Le Vau. The location chosen was excellent: facing south, it’s protected from the cold of the prevailing winds by its position under the Parterre du Midi. Twenty years later, Jules Hardouin-Mansart doubled the length of this first orangery, as well as its width, to make it the immense building preserved today. The central gallery is over 150 meters long and its vault culminates at 13 meters high. Two return galleries end under the monumental staircases of the Cent-Marches which play the role of buttresses to the whole. It was built under the ‘Italian model”, that is, in stone, with walls 4 to 5 meters thick, double glazing of the bays and a Southern exposure to maintain warmer temperatures even in winter. - To preserve their scent throughout the year, the gardeners lit bonfires to keep the trees warm, mixing the warm scent of burning woods with the orange, lemon, and oleander blossoms’ fragrance. To enhance the ambience even further and amuse the Court, small bird-shaped ornaments known as Oiselets de Chypre, would be produced out of a fragrant paste and hung from tree branches. - Another famous scented preparation was the Pommade de Florence, a popular concoction made of Florentine iris, fashionable with the French ladies and greatly appreciated by the King. - Louis’ signature mixture, ‘Acqua Angeli’ (L’Eau d’Ange), consisted of a mixture of nutmeg, clove, and other resins boiled in rose water. Jasmine, orange blossom and a few grains of musk were added for his shirts to be rinsed in the sweetly scented water.

results.name: ARQUISTE PEAU 100ml
results.description: The nape of the neck, the idealised scent at a lover and a lost embrace. Peau is based on Roman Emperor Hadrian's memories of Antinoös, his lost lover. The soft, salty and musky scent is an evocation of youth and life. From top, heart and base notes, it includes in itself the promise of intimacy and the indescribable memory of skin. With main notes of: Ambergris, clean musk accord, clary sage, white pepper from India, labdanum derivatives and okoume wood from Gabon. History AD 134, Villa Adriana, Tivoli, Italy. Such was the love emperor Hadrian had for his favourite Antinoös, that he commissioned thousands of sculptures to memorialize him after his demise. Like the contours of a statue, the physical and spiritual presence of the body is likewise defined by a fragrant silhouette. Here is the emperor recalling his lover: the touch and smell of him, the warm redolence of skin, the soft musk at the nape of the neck. Paying tribute to the beloved, like Hadrian did Antinoös, this fragrance captures the memory of skin, conjuring intimacy and closeness, and living in our hearts and minds as an idealized scent. Developed with Rodrigo Flores-Roux TOP NOTES Ambergris accord, Proprietary musk accord Clary sage HEART NOTES White pepper from India Coriander seed Sargassum BASE NOTES Leather-like labdanum derivatives Okoume wood from Gabon Ambermax Description Peau focuses on the tragic love story between Hadrian and Antinoös, allowing us to explore the theme of adoration. Hadrian exalted Antinoös’ image through thousands of statues and portraits, showing us how the antique world defined the spiritual presence in the physical shape of the body. For perfumers, the olfactive memory of skin becomes another tool to idealise and preserve in our memory the contours of physical love. Eau de Parfum. Large 100 ml / 3.4 fl oz. bottle of the highest Italian quality with our signature ‘A’ engraved metal cap, as well as the newest technology for an invisible spray tube. More research - An Imperial romance: The reign of emperor Hadrian (ruled AD 117-38) was marked by military campaigns and building projects, including the famous wall across the north of England at the edge of the Roman Empire. Hadrian had married into the imperial family, but in his late forties he met a Greek youth named Antinoös (or Antinous) from Bithynia, now in modern Turkey, possibly during a tour of the province in AD 123. The young ephebe became the emperor’s lover. During an imperial tour of Egypt in AD 130 according to an ancient biography: “while he was sailing on the Nile he lost his Antinoös, for whom he wept like a woman. About this there are several rumours, some claiming that he had devoted himself to death for Hadrian’s sake, other’s claiming what his physique and Hadrian’s sensuality suggest (i.e. that he was growing too old for the emperor’s desire). Hadrian founded a city called Antinoopolis at the place where his lover died, and made him into a god- an honour usually reserved for member’s of the emperor’s family. Hadrian publicly commemorated Antinoös in huge numbers of statues, figures, portraits and coins across the known Roman world, an almost unparalleled memorial to a lost love. - Against pessimism, the virtue of melancholy lies in defining a memory against the “dark void”. A memory can be compared to a portrait defined in our mind like the fine lines of shapes and figures against an opaque background. The memory of a loved one, of their skin, of an idealised memory or experience, remains in our minds longer than the actual material body it evokes. This is also the memory of something lost. In the Antique world, the spiritual world takes the shape of man: preserving the contours of its physical presence, i.e. the human body, is the only way to memorialise it through the passing of centuries. - PEAU is the olfactive restoration of the human body, a subliming epitaph through our sense of smell. It’s soft cruelty lies in its evocation of youth, thus life, which by nature is impermanent. From top, heart and base notes, it includes in itself the fullest promise the full spectrum of life, from beginning to end.

results.name: P.FRAPIN & CIE: Checkmate EDP 100ml
results.description: Henri Frapin likes to relax on these springtime Sundays in the garden opposite the property, built in 1702 and located above the production site. He contemplates this region made up of woodland, rivers and pastures where he was born and which is in his blood. He considers the manna provided by this nectar that the family has produced since 1889. His favourite time is when his son joins him at around 11am when the sun’s rays warm up this headland of forest above Segonzac. The chessboard stands ready. His son sits and wordlessly resumes this metaphorical battle, the togetherness with his father in the pleasures of the game. The spring breeze brings with it the refreshing fragrances of the surrounding groves. The sun warms the citrus fruits which ripen in the terracotta pot on the table while the iris and heliotropes which line the path leading to the perron discard their coverings of dew and open up to fill the air with their scents. Henri serves his son his traditional cardamom tea, a spice which shares its origins with this age-old game. Both players strive to checkmate the other while at the same time putting off the moment with a view to prolonging these special moments, this bridge between two generations, this connection of fatherly love which will bond them together forever.
