results.name: Creed Viking Cologne EDP 100ml
results.description: Creed Viking Cologne EDP 100ml — First Light over the Fjords Creed Viking Cologne EDP 100ml combines the invigorating spirit of a classic cologne with the structure and refinement of an Eau de Parfum. Bergamot, lemon, mandarin and pink pepper create a vivid citrus-spice opening; geranium, lavender, nutmeg, rosemary and sage form an aromatic heart; and sandalwood, frankincense, patchouli, cedarwood and vetiver leave a clean, enduring woody trail. The generous 100ml full retail bottle is designed for frequent wear. Viking Cologne feels adventurous without roughness, fresh without simplicity and polished enough to move from business and travel to relaxed weekends and warm-weather evenings. Viking Cologne at a Glance Fragrance style: Fresh aromatic, spicy and woody Concentration: Eau de Parfum Top notes: Bergamot, lemon, mandarin and pink pepper Heart notes: Geranium, lavender, nutmeg, rosemary and sage Base notes: Sandalwood, frankincense, patchouli, cedarwood and vetiver Format: 100ml full retail spray bottle Best suited to: Work, travel, daytime events, warm weather and energetic signature wear The Brighter Expression of the Viking Spirit Viking Cologne translates the original Viking’s sense of determination into a lighter, more open composition. Citrus creates immediate movement, aromatic herbs give the fragrance direction and dry woods provide enough structure to keep the freshness from feeling fleeting. The result is not a traditional fleeting cologne. Pink pepper and nutmeg add tension, lavender and geranium bring polish, while frankincense and vetiver give the base a quiet mineral depth. The fragrance feels like cool air meeting warm wood at first light. The Olfactive Architecture Bergamot, Lemon, Mandarin and Pink Pepper: The First Spark Bergamot and lemon provide crisp definition, mandarin adds softer radiance and pink pepper creates a lively spicy edge. The opening is bright and energetic, but its clean bitterness keeps it refined rather than sweet. Geranium, Lavender, Nutmeg, Rosemary and Sage: The Aromatic Heart Lavender and geranium create a polished fougère structure, while rosemary and sage introduce herbal freshness. Nutmeg adds dry warmth, giving the heart greater texture and carrying the fragrance from citrus into woods. Sandalwood, Frankincense, Patchouli, Cedarwood and Vetiver: The Enduring Base Sandalwood smooths the composition, cedarwood and vetiver add dry structure, patchouli creates depth and frankincense introduces a subtle smoky lift. The dry-down remains clean and composed, with enough character to support year-round wear. How Viking Cologne Develops on Skin The first stage is luminous and citrus-led. As it settles, lavender, rosemary, sage and geranium become clearer, creating a cool aromatic centre. The final phase becomes drier and woodier, with vetiver, cedarwood and frankincense leaving a refined trail. Warm New Zealand weather can amplify the citrus and herbs, while cooler conditions may emphasise the woods, patchouli and incense. Skin chemistry determines whether the fragrance appears especially bright, aromatic, spicy or dry. Who Should Choose Creed Viking Cologne? Viking Cologne suits someone who enjoys fresh niche fragrances with energy and structure. It is ideal for wearers who appreciate citrus, aromatic herbs, lavender, vetiver and dry woods, but want something lighter and more effortless than the original Viking. Choose Viking Cologne for brightness and everyday versatility. For greater spice, peppermint and intensity, explore Creed Viking . For greener classical elegance, consider Creed Green Irish Tweed . When to Wear It in New Zealand Viking Cologne is particularly suited to spring, summer and mild autumn. It works naturally for offices, business travel, lunches, daytime celebrations, weekends, outdoor occasions and warm evenings. Its woody base also gives it enough structure for cooler daytime wear. Its crisp aromatic character pairs well with shirts, polos, lightweight tailoring, knitwear and elevated casual clothing. Apply two to four sprays according to the setting, using a lighter application in close professional environments. Explore the House of Creed Creed Viking — bolder peppermint, spice and woods with a more forceful aromatic profile. Creed Green Irish Tweed — green aromatics, lavender and mossy woods with timeless tailoring. Creed Himalaya — citrus, mineral spice and polished woods with an adventurous edge. Creed Aventus Cologne — luminous bergamot, cool ginger and smooth musk with modern ease. Why Choose the 100ml Bottle? The 100ml full retail presentation is ideal for frequent wear, travel and anyone choosing Viking Cologne as a versatile signature fragrance. Its fresh aromatic character makes the larger bottle particularly practical for regular use. How to Apply and Care for Viking Cologne Apply two to four sprays to clean, dry skin at the neck, chest, wrists or inner elbows. Let the fragrance dry naturally without rubbing. Store the bottle upright in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, strong heat and humidity. Why Buy Creed from Gadgets Online NZ? results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME Aphélie 15ml
results.description: Trudon perfumes contain an olfactory complexity that hints at a character rather than a genre. They cast light on Trudon’s ethos: to promote creative freedom and invoke unique horizons. Aphélie stands out in a unique manner : like an aphelion - the orbital point at which a celestial object is furthest from the sun - she lights up. Mysterious, Aphélie is connected to the cosmos : subject to the laws of attraction, she makes one with nature. Head Notes Rose Essence , Green Ivy Heart Notes Blackcurrant Bud, Moss Base Notes Sandalwood, Tonka Beans

results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME Bruma 15ml
results.description: BRUMA A ray of sunlight spreads with the strength of a shadow. Creation: Antoine Lie Sensuality: Bruma contains a distinguished, almost animal-like sensuality. In the night, a feminine rider draws inner strength from the elements that surround her: her horse and the depth of the forest at night seem to give her a magnetic and carnal aura. Bruma (“solstice” in Latin) is intrinsically tied to the sun. And to royalty. An icy solstice, Bruma feeds on the moon and the forest to evoke the inner metamorphosis of a character in contact with the nature surrounding her. “A noble figure leaves the comfort of her rooms on horseback at night to discover a part of herself in another, nearly supernatural place. Her appearance is evoked by the notes that transcribe her femininity as well as her elevated rank. The rider crosses a clearing, passing from the half-dark into the nocturnal light, shrouded in mystery, enigma and a distinguished sensuality that is almost animal-like. Her beauty is suddenly revealed by a spiritual energy.” - Antoine Lie. Pyramid Head: Black pepper, lavender, galbanum Heart: Violets, purple peony, iris, jasmine sambac Base: Labdanum, Haitian vetiver, tonka bean

results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME Elae 15ml
results.description: Elae by Cire Trudon Elae wears its femininity like a luminous offering: it unfolds like a bouquet of white petals with woody notes, filled with warmth and tenderness. Of proud descent, Elae is embedded, through her Latin name, with the protective aura of Diana, goddess of the hunt. A clear evocation of faraway lands that need to be conquered, Elae is fragrant with flowers yet bears a narcotic sensuality. Elae unfolds like a transparent floral perfume with light notes that float. Fragrance Notes: TOP NOTES: Néroli africain, pomme, bergamote HEART NOTES : Ylang-ylang, Egyptian jasmine, Indian tuberose BASE NOTES : Australian sandalwood, Laotian benzoin, akigalawood Eau de parfum 100ml

results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME II Deux 15ml
results.description: II (pronounced “Deux”) A green note that unites. Creation: Lyn Harris Sensuality: II is about new beginnings; the life of a forest that permeates through the seasons. It is sensually symbiotic, bringing elements together: a Cologne that inspires and points at a magical place. II is the alliance par excellence, the unique link that ties two beings together. II transcends and calls to the pious, revealing its fragrance like an emerald impulse. “This perfume’s vibrant greenery is a forest painting: pines, juniper and cedar covered in moss and berries on a damp, earthy floor. II is a modern take on eau de Cologne; a green, peppery scent with orange bigarade from Brazil. It’s something for everyone that unites and brings two people together.” - Lyn Harris. Pyramid Heat: Green leaves, orange bigarade Heart: Pines, pepper, juniper Base: Cedar, incense, Ambroxan, Cashmeran

results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME Medie 15ml
results.description: Cire Trudon – A journey with a heart of citrus. A coolness that runs on the skin, leaving a desirable trace of amber and leather on the surface. Médie is a symphony of citrus: the roots of perfume evoke Antiquity and the kingdom of Alexander the Great, under which the province of Médie abounded with rare citrus fruits. An oasis of freshness, Médie encapsulates the very heart of the fruit where citrus fruits, spices and aromatic notes mingle. In addition, bright green scents are combined with clear notes of amber and wood, warmed by a touch of incense. Composed as a citrus scent with an aromatic finish, Médie leaves a strong bitterness in the air. Maison Trudon, master of high perfumery, unveils Elae and Médie to complete the collection. Trudon fragrances contain an olfactory complexity that refers to a character rather than a genre. Built from noble and natural ingredients, they highlight Cire Trudon’s ethics: to promote the freedom of creation and to invoke unique horizons. Designed by Yann Vasnier – the nose behind Mortel – the new fragrances bring freshness, fluidity and femininity to the collection, in perfect harmony with our times. Fragrance notes: Top note: Grapefruit, Mandarin, Angelica Heart note: Jasmine, Cypress, Wood Basic note: Texas Cedarwood, Incense, Wood

results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME Mortel 15ml
results.description: MORTEL A mystical presence, deep-rooted and spicy. Creation: Yann Vasnier Sensuality: Skins heat up against one another, placing sensuality is at the heart of Mortel; more, frankincense, myrrh and benzoin reveal the erotic spell of pure Cistus. The artist, living between shadow and light, is a mortal creature. Halfway between the religious and the revolutionary, with an unquenched thirst for eternity, Mortel is a revolutionary drive that combines virile force and natural harmonies. A fatal attraction. “A winter’s night. A heavy metal door opens on a huge room. A man appears in the distance; intense heat and light are pulsing from a forge. Light is reflected on the skin and gestures of this man, who is engaged in a rite: standing in front of the blaze, his eyes seek a form buried in the magma before he can recreate it in the open air. The furnace throws giant, moving shadows. In the midst of his activity, sleep finally overcomes the fiery eyes of the artist-craftsman.” - Yann Vasnier. Pyramid Head: Black pepper, pimento, nutmeg Heart: Somalian frankincense, Mystikal, Virginia cedar Base: Pure cistus, myrrh, benzoin

results.name: CIRE TRUDON PERFUME Revolution 15ml
results.description: REVOLUTION A smoky messenger of both a beginning and an end. Creation: Lyn Harris Sensuality: Revolution is a fragrance that permeates the skin, and builds up on human emotions throughout the day. It blends in, leaving an air of mystery and intrigue around the body. The streets of Paris during the French Revolution, an odour of smoke and musket powder. Rage and intense emotions on the faces of the crowds. Houses are afire, and the cobblestones awash in oil; horses are whinnying; their and sweaty riders are robed in black leather. A touch of incense softens the air, suggesting peace is near. “Revolution captures a moment in history, a period when smells were raw and prevailed everywhere. History is alive in this composition where smoke, wood, leather and incense reign. Yet modern elements in the formula let the scent breathe. A form of harmony is born out of these contrasting notes, leaving an elegant, clean, smoky wood-scented backdrop that remains on the skin.” - Lyn Harris. Pyramid Head: Elemi Heart: Angelique Base: Cedar, papyrus, patchouli, cade, incense, pure cistus, opoponax

This intoxicating scent opens with a bold blend of Cardamom, Mandarin, and Saffron, before revealing a heart of Incense, Iris, and Orange Blossom Absolute—a nod to Louis XIV's love for this iconic flower. The fragrance is anchored by rich base notes of Guaiac Wood, Cedar, and Tonka Bean, offering warmth and depth. A tribute to power, elegance, and the timeless beauty of nature, Absolu is an addictive composition that captures the opulence of haute perfumery. Fragrance pyramid top Cardamom, Mandarin, Saffron Heart Notes Incense, Iris, Orange blossom absolute Fragrance pyramid bottom Guaiac wood, Cedarwood, Tonka Beans

results.name: TRUDON PERFUME Vixi 15ml
results.description: A luminous ode to life. Vixi is the latest addition to the Trudon fragrance collection, featuring a fresh, aromatic and woody note. A journey towards lightness, Vixi reveals the spiritual strength of a Nepalese sandalwood, the sacred nature of sage, the freshness of bitter orange petit grain natural oil and the flowery perfume of jasmine essence. Experienced nose Emilie Bouge imagined Vixi like a flow of life filled with clarity, an exploration of inner light. Featuring precious Nepalese sandalwood, praised by oriental philosophies, and sage, used in purification rituals, Vixi welcomes a renaissance, a regenerative scent filled with wisdom. Fragrance pyramid top Cardamom, Natural Italian petitgrain essence Heart Notes Natural essence of Balkan sage, Santal Fragrance pyramid bottom Cedarwood, Jasmine

results.name: P.FRAPIN & CIE: Bois Blanc EDP 15ml
results.description: Our personal and professional lives follow the circadian rhythm of days and nights, the changing of the seasons, the wind blowing in the trees. This closeness to nature sustains us more than one might think. We model nature and are modelled by it, surrounded as we are by meadows, vines, rivers and woods. Wood is our age-old wisdom. We listen to its lessons and secrets. Its verticality shows us the only way forward, that of ascending. It is at times hot, enveloping, aromatic or deep. It strongly underscores our style; that of Bois Blanc. Top Notes: Essence of bitter orange, Essence of mandarin, Essence of eucalyptus, Essence of rosemary, Essence of ginger Heart Notes: Essence of sage, Essence of Virginian cedar wood, Essence of violet Leaf Base Notes: Ambroxan, Essence of Guaiac wood, Essence of cade wood

results.name: P.FRAPIN & CIE: Checkmate EDP 15ml
results.description: Henri Frapin likes to relax on these springtime Sundays in the garden opposite the property, built in 1702 and located above the production site. He contemplates this region made up of woodland, rivers and pastures where he was born and which is in his blood. He considers the manna provided by this nectar that the family has produced since 1889. His favourite time is when his son joins him at around 11am when the sun’s rays warm up this headland of forest above Segonzac. The chessboard stands ready. His son sits and wordlessly resumes this metaphorical battle, the togetherness with his father in the pleasures of the game. The spring breeze brings with it the refreshing fragrances of the surrounding groves. The sun warms the citrus fruits which ripen in the terracotta pot on the table while the iris and heliotropes which line the path leading to the perron discard their coverings of dew and open up to fill the air with their scents. Henri serves his son his traditional cardamom tea, a spice which shares its origins with this age-old game. Both players strive to checkmate the other while at the same time putting off the moment with a view to prolonging these special moments, this bridge between two generations, this connection of fatherly love which will bond them together forever.

results.name: P.FRAPIN & CIE: IF EDP 15ml
results.description: Eau De Parfum By Frapin “I was lucky enough to travel from the north to the south of India during a charity race this year and on passing through Mysore, the verses of “If” came to me. It was my grandfather, a great traveller if ever there was one, who introduced me to this poem when I was a child. This lesson that needs to be repeated every day in order to become what we are”: David Frossard, artistic director of Parfums Frapin. Top notes: Fresh ginger from Madagascar, pepper from Karnataka, Italian bergamot Heart notes: Fig milk, Ceylon cinnamon, cashmere wood Base notes: Sandalwood from Mysore, patchouli from Indonesia, Guaiac wood from Peru, tonka bean from Venezuela

results.name: FORT & MANLÉ All The Queen's Men 50ml EDP
results.description: All the Queen’s Men Dedicated to her majesty, they are born to serve their posts. Nursed and fed until ready to do the work of collecting nature's dust and converting it to liquid gold, they now nurse and feed the next generation. Striped and fit for the many tasks to keep the castle strong, they assemble and carry out her will. Converting flower dust into nature’s greatest elixir is not as hard as it seems. The great nectar bar of spring unfolds its brilliant colours, giving out samples to its busy customers. Buzzing and bumping from bloom to bloom, piggybacking Spring’s bold bouquet, these busy workers inspire a scent worthy of the queen herself. Rich, floral, fresh. It takes all the Queen’s Men to produce such an immaculate fragrance. Spring orchestra tunes its strings Buzzing waves hum, bump and go The avant-garde dance of colour Restores the painter’s palette With hope and inspiration Fulfilling her majesty’s wish For never-ending bounty Notes Dried Fruit, Honey, Rum, Vanilla, Cinnamon, Fir balsam, Woods. DISCLAIMER: Due to the nature of the natural raw materials used in our fragrances, the perfumes may vary slightly between batches. ABOUT: Fort & Manlé is a luxury niche perfume house committed to creating high-quality handcrafted perfume. Founder and perfumer Rasei Fort has elevated the art of scent creation to new heights, bringing the essence of the world’s most treasured aromas into exciting compositions. Vibrant, opulent, and often eccentric, his inspired creations combine the most refined and precious raw materials available. Now synonymous with luxury around the world, Fort & Manlé continues to raise the bar, providing an olfactory experience that is sure to transport its users to the most exotic places and times. Self-taught, well researched, and meticulous in his methods, Rasei blends artisanal oils and extracts to create a nuanced balance that is truly unique to Fort & Manlé. Bringing together modern and “old world” sensibilities, from the rich pageantry of great empires to the seductive allure of romantic seduction, and the fresh paradise of exotic isles, the rich and inspired aromas created for Fort & Manlé are as evocative as the imagination of our founder.

results.name: FORT & MANLÉ Bojnokopff 50ml EDP
results.description: Bojnokopff Smokey rooms tucked away behind posh clubs in 1897 St Petersburg conjure images of dedicated followers of magic. Kerosene lamp light in the haze of tobacco and ornate mirrors creates the scene for the perfect illusion. Dark and hypnotic, his voice is calm and deep. “Tsilindr.” A single word, as he removes his famous purple top hat and lowers it down again, gently atop his head. Mysterious, yet delicate. This inspired blend conjures a full and rich western sensibility with its masterful shades of French Lavender and Vanilla atop depths of rich chocolate and unctuous textures. The greatest finale happens when the man is gone and we still feel his presence, embodied forever in a singular object, the purple top hat that inspired this namesake fragrance. The great Mr. Bojnokopff His whereabouts are always known By those who have had the pleasure To hear his voice and feel The mystery of his greatest trick To be remembered without being seen. Is it real or just an illusion? Notes French lavender, Vanilla, Dark chocolate, Oud, Cedarwood. results.name: Floris London Bouquet De La Reine EDT 10ml
results.description: Embrace curiosity, experience a warm rush of violet leaf, juicy blackcurrant buds and sensuous tuberose. Always surrounded by laughter, colour, friends and loved ones, Bouquet de La Reine has a magnetic energy and charismatic allure. The enticing soft fruitiness of fresh peaches combines with jasmine and rose entwined with exotic tuberose and ylang-ylang as the radiant floral heart unfolds and is brought back to earth with a base of rich green oakmoss, sandalwood and vanilla. Taking on the imperial life. Delectable notes of a fruity floral effervescence bring a golden glow and a warm smile. Elegant and positive, Bouquet de La Reine has instant chemistry. Created for a queen of the royal court, a radiant reflection of timeless beauty. Bouquet de La Reine – the Queen’s bouquet – was created by Mr Floris as a wedding gift for Queen Victoria when she married Prince Albert in 1840. The fragrance was then added to the Floris repertoire in 1860. A modern contemporary adaptation of this perfume was created and introduced to celebrate the Golden Jubilee of the late Queen Elizabeth II.

results.name: Floris London Cefiro EDT 10ml
results.description: Crisp lemon and lime, punctuated with bergamot and mandarin, warmed by spicy notes of cardamom and nutmeg on a fresh floral jasmine heart that leads to a clean, musky, woody base. A fresh floral jasmine heart that leads to a clean, musky, woody base, making Cefiro a fragrance perfectly suited for both men and women. Cefiro is the Spanish word for 'zephyr,' meaning a gentle breeze. The fragrance was launched into the Floris range in 2002 and is inspired by the feeling of a warm gentle breeze while relaxing in a Mediterranean courtyard. Picture faded glamour, weathered terracotta tiles gently worn by time and a fruity tipple to complete the experience.

results.name: Floris London Mulberry Fig EDP 10ml
results.description: Mulberry Fig is a scent that evokes a floral amber fragrance combining the soft powdery character of orris with hints of fruit and spice. The perfume opens with a sparkle of fig and cardamom supported from the heart with fragrant green tones of vetiver and cypress. Amyris, cedarwood and sandalwood emphasise the overall woody character that permeates through the perfume. A quick promenade away from our Jermyn Street shop lies St James's, one of London’s oldest Royal Parks, surrounded by some of the country’s most famous landmarks and lush greenery. Creamy sweet and bitter green aromas encompass the shoreline of the blissful lake towered by an abundance of fig trees, immense in scale with elongated deciduous leaves flaunting their architectural foliage, believed to be the largest in Britain.

results.name: Floris London No.89 EDT 10ml
results.description: Warmed with a touch of spicy nutmeg, the floral heart is underscored by the dominant woody accord of sandalwood, cedarwood and vetiver. This is a quintessentially English fragrance. If you’re looking to secure a new signature fragrance that promises to stand the test of time, look no further than the iconic No. 89 Eau de Toilette. A classic elegant cologne of impeccable style and provenance. Introduced in 1951, No. 89 takes its name from the number of the Floris shop and perfumery in London’s Jermyn Street. This building was originally the family home and remains very much the beating heart of our perfume house today. No. 89 was created in the sub-basement at 89 Jermyn Street which was traditionally and affectionally known as ‘The Mine’. All our fragrances were created here until the late 1970s.

results.name: Floris London Platinum 22 EDP 10ml
results.description: Opening with top notes of cool orris, rounded by the comforting scent of oats. Lifted with a sparkle of blackcurrant and lime. Platinum 22 gently yields to the radiant heart notes of rich rose with violet leaves, clary sage and black tea. A touch of black pepper adds a hint of spice. The fragrance then concludes with the warm, woody base note of cedarwood. This is enriched by a harmony of smooth amber, musk and tonka bean. Exclusively created to honour the historic milestone of the Platinum Jubilee and celebrate the late Queen Elizabeth II. The fragrance takes its inspiration from the flora of the beautiful gardens that surrounded her UK residences. Platinum 22 was also created as a reflection on The Queen’s 70 years of service and the many people she inspired during her remarkable reign. In support of The Queen’s Green Canopy initiative, Floris chose to “Plant a Tree for The Jubilee”. Each tree planted as part of the scheme represented one year of Her Majesty’s service.

results.name: Floris London Santal EDT 10ml
results.description: Warm spices of black pepper, nutmeg and clove are woven with a sensual aromatic heart of lavender. The perfume's success lies in the complex woody amber base blended perfectly with dry woods of sandalwood, cedarwood, patchouli and vetiver which are complimented with frankincense, musk, tonka and vanilla. Santal takes its inspiration from a Floris Sandalwood fragrance, originally created in the 1800s. A fragrance that captures the mystique and allure of the East, a journey to the heart of India, where the scent of sandalwood fills the air. A perfume created with the finest sandalwood oil and blended with a selection of other precious essences. Rejoicing its distinctive makeup as a true signature scent, Santal is a fragrance to excite the senses. A timeless sandalwood fragrance which embodies elegance, luxury, and a touch of exotic mystery. Perfect for after-dark soirees, distinctive entrances, and crisp mornings.

results.name: Floris London White Rose EDT 10ml
results.description: Meet the new bloom, confident and modern, self-assured and warm, an elegant contradiction of silk and spice. Discover a bouquet of velvet roses, sparkling with an unexpected splash of cool iris, wrapped in warm amber and rich, earthy musk. Uncover a story of contrasts –the old world and the new, the perfect with the imperfect, drama and poise, town and country. Drawing on the creative home of the Floris family, White Rose has its heart in London’s Mayfair. Surrounded by beauty and art, fashion and architecture, the scene forms a natural backdrop for the scent’s timeless vibrancy. White Rose was originally created in the early 1800s. It was crafted at our Jermyn Street shop in London by Mr John Floris. The fragrance was a favourite of Florence Nightingale.She had bottles shipped out to her while nursing in the Crimea war. You can read a treasured letter from Florence in our Jermyn Street shop, where it is on display. In the letter, she expresses her gratitude to Mr Floris and her favourite fragrance, White Rose.

results.name: Terrible Teddy by Penhaligon's 75ml EDP
results.description: Terrible Teddy by Penhaligon's 75ml Eau De Parfum Spray for Men Teddy lives for the thrill of the chase, ensnaring unsuspecting hearts with his scent of leather, incense and ambroxan. results.description: Creed Delphinus EDP 100ml — Orris and Amber Beneath a Starlit Sky Creed Delphinus EDP 100ml is a luminous woody amber fragrance shaped by incense, pepper, almond and precious orris. Heliotrope and orchid soften the heart, while patchouli, tonka bean, amberwood, leather and Bourbon vanilla create a warm, enveloping base. The composition glows rather than burns—smooth, celestial and quietly magnetic. Presented in a generous 100ml full retail bottle, Delphinus rewards repeated wear. Its powdery textures, smoky opening and leathery vanilla dry-down reveal different facets across seasons and skin, making it a compelling signature for someone who prefers amber with elegance rather than obvious sweetness. Delphinus at a Glance Fragrance style: Woody amber, orris and leathery Concentration: Eau de Parfum Top notes: Black pepper, incense, almond and pink pepper Heart notes: Heliotrope, orchid and orris butter Base notes: Patchouli, tonka bean, amberwood, leather accord and Bourbon vanilla from Madagascar Format: 100ml full retail spray bottle Best suited to: Evenings, formal events, cooler weather, intimate occasions and sophisticated signature wear The Luminous Side of Creed’s Amber Universe Delphinus takes its name from a constellation historically associated with guidance and light. The fragrance reflects that idea through contrasts of darkness and radiance: smoky incense against bright pepper, almond warmth against cool orris, and leather against polished vanilla. Where Centaurus is fiery and expansive, Delphinus is smoother and more atmospheric. Its richness is filtered through powdery florals and orris butter, giving the composition a refined texture that feels almost illuminated from within. The Olfactive Architecture Black Pepper, Incense, Almond and Pink Pepper: Smoke and Light The opening balances resinous incense with the sparkle of black and pink pepper. Almond adds immediate softness and a gentle nutty warmth, preventing the smoke from becoming severe. The result is intriguing and textured from the first spray. Heliotrope, Orchid and Orris Butter: A Precious, Powdered Heart Heliotrope extends the almond-like warmth, while orchid adds a smooth floral dimension. Orris butter gives the heart its most luxurious texture: powdery, cool and softly earthy. This stage is where Delphinus feels most luminous and distinctive. Patchouli, Tonka, Amberwood, Leather and Bourbon Vanilla: The Nocturnal Base Patchouli and amberwood create structure, leather adds a subtle dark contour, and tonka bean introduces warm sweetness. Bourbon vanilla smooths the finish without turning it confectionery. The dry-down feels enveloping, elegant and quietly sensual. How Delphinus Develops on Skin The fragrance begins with pepper and incense, then quickly gains softness from almond. Through the heart, heliotrope and orris create a velvety, powdery texture. The dry-down becomes warmer and deeper as leather, tonka and vanilla settle around the woody amber base. In cool New Zealand weather, the incense, orris and leather may feel more defined. On warmer skin, almond, tonka and vanilla can become more prominent. Delphinus is best experienced patiently, allowing its texture to change rather than judging it only from the opening. Who Should Choose Creed Delphinus? Delphinus suits someone who enjoys warm amber fragrances but prefers sophistication over density. It is an excellent choice for admirers of orris, almond, soft leather and polished vanilla. The fragrance is universal and can be worn by anyone drawn to its balance of smoke, powder and warmth. Choose Delphinus when you want an elegant, luminous amber. For stronger tobacco and spice, explore Creed Centaurus . For darker fruit and floral richness, consider Creed Carmina . When to Wear Delphinus in New Zealand Delphinus is especially compelling in autumn, winter and cool spring evenings. It works for dinners, formal events, date nights, celebrations, theatre, intimate gatherings and refined signature wear. Its powdery amber character complements tailoring, fine knitwear, silk, velvet and elegant outerwear. Begin with two sprays in close settings and allow the fragrance time to unfold; its warmth develops gradually and can become more expressive as the skin heats. Explore the House of Creed Creed Centaurus — hotter and bolder, with tobacco, cinnamon, cardamom and rich vanilla. Creed Carmina — dark cherry, saffron, layered florals and warm resins. Creed Royal Oud — structured woods and spice with formal elegance. Creed Love In Black — a darker floral fragrance with an enigmatic evening mood. Why Choose the 100ml Bottle? The 100ml full retail bottle is designed for regular wear, collectors and anyone choosing Delphinus as a signature amber fragrance. For fragrance rotation, travel or a smaller commitment, explore Creed Delphinus 50ml . How to Apply and Care for Delphinus Apply two to four sprays to clean, dry skin at the neck, chest or inner elbows. Start conservatively in enclosed settings and allow the incense, orris and ambered base to develop naturally. Avoid rubbing the skin after application. Store the bottle upright in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, strong heat and humidity. Performance varies according to body chemistry, climate, application and storage. results.name: Creed Centaurus EDP 100ml
results.description: Creed Centaurus EDP 100ml — A Constellation of Fire and Amber Creed Centaurus EDP 100ml is one of the House’s boldest modern compositions: a woody amber fragrance illuminated by tobacco, cardamom, cinnamon and pink pepper. Sandalwood, heliotrope, jasmine and geranium soften the fire at its centre, while benzoin, Tolu balm, tonka bean, ambroxan and Bourbon vanilla create a deep, glowing finish. Presented in a generous 100ml full retail bottle, Centaurus is designed for someone who wants fragrance to make an impression. Its warmth is expansive, but the construction remains polished—spice is balanced by flowers, tobacco by creamy woods, and dark sweetness by an ambered architectural base. Centaurus at a Glance Fragrance style: Woody amber, tobacco and spicy Concentration: Eau de Parfum Top notes: Cardamom, cinnamon, tobacco and pink pepper Heart notes: Geranium, sandalwood, heliotrope, jasmine and patchouli Base notes: Benzoin, Tolu balm, tonka bean, ambroxan and Bourbon vanilla from Madagascar Format: 100ml full retail spray bottle Best suited to: Evenings, formal events, cooler weather, dinners and distinctive signature wear The Fiery Side of Creed’s Amber Universe Centaurus takes its name from one of the sky’s largest constellations and translates that scale into scent. The composition begins with incandescent spice and tobacco, then reveals a smoother floral-woody heart before settling into a rich ambered base. It feels cinematic, but never uncontrolled. Its strength comes from contrast. Cinnamon and cardamom create heat, while pink pepper gives the opening lift. Tobacco adds shadow and texture. Sandalwood and heliotrope then soften the centre, and the resins, tonka and Bourbon vanilla create a dark golden glow in the dry-down. The Olfactive Architecture Cardamom, Cinnamon, Tobacco and Pink Pepper: The Ignition The opening is immediate and warm. Cardamom brings aromatic freshness, cinnamon adds a glowing spicy heat, and pink pepper creates brightness around the edges. Tobacco gives the accord depth and a faintly smoky richness, making the first impression bold without becoming harsh. Geranium, Sandalwood, Heliotrope, Jasmine and Patchouli: The Tempered Heart The heart introduces texture and balance. Sandalwood brings a creamy smoothness, heliotrope adds a soft almond-like warmth, and jasmine gives the composition lift. Geranium contributes aromatic clarity, while patchouli creates a darker line that connects the heart to the ambered base. Benzoin, Tolu Balm, Tonka, Ambroxan and Bourbon Vanilla: The Lasting Glow The base is rich and enveloping. Benzoin and Tolu balm create resinous warmth, tonka adds a honeyed tobacco-like sweetness, and Bourbon vanilla rounds the composition with depth rather than confectionery softness. Ambroxan reinforces the structure and helps the trail remain smooth and enduring. How Centaurus Develops on Skin The first stage is the most fiery, with spice and tobacco creating a vivid aura. As the fragrance settles, sandalwood, florals and patchouli become more noticeable, making the composition smoother and more dimensional. The final stage is warmer and more intimate, with resins, tonka and vanilla creating a deep ambered trail. Cool New Zealand weather can emphasise the tobacco, resins and woods, while warmer skin may bring the vanilla and tonka forward more quickly. Because Centaurus is richly constructed, a measured application often reveals more detail than an excessive one. Who Should Choose Creed Centaurus? Centaurus suits someone who enjoys luxurious amber fragrances with visible spice, tobacco and vanilla, but wants the refinement of a niche composition rather than simple sweetness. It is expressive, confident and particularly effective for evening wear. Choose Centaurus when you want heat, depth and projection. For a smoother, more luminous member of the Amber Universe, explore Creed Delphinus . For aromatic spice with a fresher character, consider Creed Viking . When to Wear Centaurus in New Zealand Centaurus is at its best through autumn, winter and cooler spring evenings. It suits dinners, date nights, formal events, celebrations, cocktail occasions and any setting where a distinctive warm fragrance feels appropriate. It pairs naturally with dark tailoring, structured coats, knitwear, leather and polished evening clothing. Begin with two sprays in enclosed environments; the fragrance’s tobacco, spices and ambered base can develop substantially as the skin warms. Explore the House of Creed Continue through richer Creed compositions with distinct interpretations of spice, woods and amber: Creed Delphinus — smoother and more luminous, with incense, almond, orris and leathery vanilla. Creed Viking — fresher and more aromatic, combining spice with a vigorous fougère character. Creed Royal Oud — elegant woods and spice with a more formal, opulent profile. Creed Bois du Portugal — drier, more classical and restrained, with citrus, spices and mossy woods. Why Choose the 100ml Bottle? The 100ml presentation is ideal for established Centaurus wearers, collectors and anyone intending to use it as a regular evening or cold-weather signature. For fragrance rotation or a more compact option, explore Creed Centaurus 50ml . How to Apply and Care for Centaurus Apply two to four sprays to clean, dry skin at the neck, chest or inner elbows. Start conservatively in close environments and allow the fragrance to develop before adding more. Avoid rubbing the skin after application. Store the bottle upright in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, strong heat and humidity. Performance and scent development vary with body chemistry, climate, application and storage. The fragrance remains composed throughout. Lavender and jasmine soften the more mineral elements, while the woody base gives the citrus opening a lasting framework. The result is energetic but polished, making Himalaya especially versatile. The Olfactive Architecture Lemon, Mandarin and Bergamot: A Bright Ascent The fragrance opens with a crisp sweep of citrus. Lemon creates definition, mandarin brings softer radiance, and bergamot gives the accord aromatic elegance. The freshness feels clean and uplifting without becoming sharp. Gunpowder, Juniper and Spice: The Distinctive Centre A cool gunpowder accord introduces Himalaya’s mineral identity. Juniper berries add an outdoorsy aromatic clarity, while nutmeg and pepper create dry warmth. The base settles close and clean, leaving a woody impression that supports regular wear across different settings. How Himalaya Evolves on Skin The opening is bright and citrus-led. As it settles, the gunpowder and juniper accord becomes more noticeable, joined by dry spice and aromatic lavender. The final stage is smoother and woodier, with sandalwood rounding the sharper facets while vetiver and cedarwood keep the trail crisp. results.name: ARQUISTE INDIGO SMOKE 7.5ml
results.description: Evoking the traditional smoking of tea leaves in ancient China, Indigo Smoke is an aromatic landscape of narrow serpentine rivers, blue mountains and incense-filled temples condensed into a complex formula of black tea, woody notes and incense. Rich, sophisticated and long-lasting. With notes of lapsang souchong tea, mandarin orange, apricot, guaiac wood, incense and pine tar. 7.5 ml / 3.4 fl oz. Eau de Parfum History May 1646, Wuyi Mountains, Fujian. For centuries, diligent monks in the Wuyi Mountains have grown tea and indigo plants in neatly terraced plantations. In 1646, their monasteries were attacked by Qing soldiers from the north. As the monks were forced to flee, they smoked batches of tea leaves over pinewood fire to preserve their crops. This would become the smoky lapsang souchong tea. Mixing with the fresh mountain air and the incense from nearby shrines, the intoxicating plumes of indigo smoke captured the colours of the Wuyi Mountains and their dramatic river narrows. Developed with Calice Becker. TOP NOTES Bergamot Mandarin orange oil Lapsang souchong accord Vetiver HEART NOTES Apricot accord Cassia oil Carrot seed oil Gaiac wood BASE NOTES Maté tea absolute Cedar leaf oil Pine tar Incense Description Created with master perfume Calice Becker, Indigo Smoke is a fragrance for every gender, inspired by the aromatic history of lapsang souchong tea. Like the mountain terraces from which it originated, it encapsulates an aromatic landscape of indigo blues, purples and greens. Eau de Parfum. Large 100 ml / 3.4 fl oz. bottle of the highest Italian quality with the signature ‘A’ engraved metal cap, as well as the newest technology for an invisible spray tube. More research - Lapsang souchong was first created in 1646, as civilians in the Wuyi Mountain areas fled from Qing soldiers who were advancing through the area on their Manchu unification campaign against the Southern Ming. Before they fled, to avoid spoilage of newly plucked leaves, batches were quickly dried over fire and buried in sacks. Afterwards, despite the odor, the tea leaves were shipped and sold to the Dutch traders. At the time, the months-long journey from China to Europe necessitated preservation methods and the partial oxidation of this Wuyi tea was better able to preserve its quality. The smoky souchong tea sold and the Dutch returned to request more. Lapsang Souchong was perhaps the first black tea ever produced and traded.The trade name would later become lapsang souchong from the Fuzhou dialect: La (pine) Sang (wood) with souchong meaning "small sort" referring to the leaves used. - In the 16th century, farmers in Wuyi began growing tea and indigo side by side on the mountainside, on estates owned by Buddhist or Taoist monasteries. The farmers cut terraces into the slopes, and built a system of dikes and drains. During the Ming dynasty, monks also developed a new technique for stopping the oxidation process of tea, pan-firing the leaves in a dry wok rather than steaming them as had been done previously. This produced a darker, more fragrant type of tea. - Lapsang souchong is manufactured similar to black tea but with an intermediary step of smoking. Traditionally pine wood is used for this, and the leaves are processed within a smoke house. The indoor withering is done with the leaves laid out on bamboo mats and turned and rolling at intervals. Many of the compounds making up its wood-smoked aroma, originate in the pine smoke and are not found in other kinds of tea. - The Wuyi Mountains are the largest and most representative example of Chinese subtropical forests, including warm coniferous, evergreen and bamboo forests. The landscape is characterised by beautiful winding river valleys flanked by dramatic columnar or dome-shaped cliffs.

results.name: ARQUISTE PEAU 7.5ml
results.description: The nape of the neck, the idealised scent at a lover and a lost embrace. Peau is based on Roman Emperor Hadrian's memories of Antinoös, his lost lover. The soft, salty and musky scent is an evocation of youth and life. From top, heart and base notes, it includes in itself the promise of intimacy and the indescribable memory of skin. With main notes of: Ambergris, clean musk accord, clary sage, white pepper from India, labdanum derivatives and okoume wood from Gabon. History AD 134, Villa Adriana, Tivoli, Italy. Such was the love emperor Hadrian had for his favourite Antinoös, that he commissioned thousands of sculptures to memorialize him after his demise. Like the contours of a statue, the physical and spiritual presence of the body is likewise defined by a fragrant silhouette. Here is the emperor recalling his lover: the touch and smell of him, the warm redolence of skin, the soft musk at the nape of the neck. Paying tribute to the beloved, like Hadrian did Antinoös, this fragrance captures the memory of skin, conjuring intimacy and closeness, and living in our hearts and minds as an idealized scent. Developed with Rodrigo Flores-Roux TOP NOTES Ambergris accord, Proprietary musk accord Clary sage HEART NOTES White pepper from India Coriander seed Sargassum BASE NOTES Leather-like labdanum derivatives Okoume wood from Gabon Ambermax Description Peau focuses on the tragic love story between Hadrian and Antinoös, allowing us to explore the theme of adoration. Hadrian exalted Antinoös’ image through thousands of statues and portraits, showing us how the antique world defined the spiritual presence in the physical shape of the body. For perfumers, the olfactive memory of skin becomes another tool to idealise and preserve in our memory the contours of physical love. Eau de Parfum. Large 100 ml / 3.4 fl oz. bottle of the highest Italian quality with our signature ‘A’ engraved metal cap, as well as the newest technology for an invisible spray tube. More research - An Imperial romance: The reign of emperor Hadrian (ruled AD 117-38) was marked by military campaigns and building projects, including the famous wall across the north of England at the edge of the Roman Empire. Hadrian had married into the imperial family, but in his late forties he met a Greek youth named Antinoös (or Antinous) from Bithynia, now in modern Turkey, possibly during a tour of the province in AD 123. The young ephebe became the emperor’s lover. During an imperial tour of Egypt in AD 130 according to an ancient biography: “while he was sailing on the Nile he lost his Antinoös, for whom he wept like a woman. About this there are several rumours, some claiming that he had devoted himself to death for Hadrian’s sake, other’s claiming what his physique and Hadrian’s sensuality suggest (i.e. that he was growing too old for the emperor’s desire). Hadrian founded a city called Antinoopolis at the place where his lover died, and made him into a god- an honour usually reserved for member’s of the emperor’s family. Hadrian publicly commemorated Antinoös in huge numbers of statues, figures, portraits and coins across the known Roman world, an almost unparalleled memorial to a lost love. - Against pessimism, the virtue of melancholy lies in defining a memory against the “dark void”. A memory can be compared to a portrait defined in our mind like the fine lines of shapes and figures against an opaque background. The memory of a loved one, of their skin, of an idealised memory or experience, remains in our minds longer than the actual material body it evokes. This is also the memory of something lost. In the Antique world, the spiritual world takes the shape of man: preserving the contours of its physical presence, i.e. the human body, is the only way to memorialise it through the passing of centuries. - PEAU is the olfactive restoration of the human body, a subliming epitaph through our sense of smell. It’s soft cruelty lies in its evocation of youth, thus life, which by nature is impermanent. From top, heart and base notes, it includes in itself the fullest promise the full spectrum of life, from beginning to end.

results.name: Neandertal Dark Perfume 30ml
results.description: Neandertal Dark Perfume 30ml Neandertal is a conceptual perfume that transcends time and space. The darker, more shadowed version of Neandertal. A scent of movement that challenges perfumery conventions. The top note structure of Neandertal dark comprises leafy, aromatic and textural sensations, symbolic of nature; trees, plants, flowers and citrus fruits. Initially, pepper berries and incense clash against this delicate foliage accord, pushing, pulling and in time combining to create a transgressive and original iodine profile as Neandertal dark evolves. Sandalwood and cedar provide a durable foundation for Neandertal dark. The inclusion of oud and leather adds unusual animalic depth and resinous shadow. Earthy rhizome materials reintroduce the familiar green facets in a darker manner. An accord comprising vetiver, patchouli and musk is offset against amber bringing both vibrancy and richness to Neandertal dark. Top notes: Foliage, Ginger, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit & Pine Heart notes: Incense, Geranium, Caraway & Seaweed Base notes: Vetiver, Patchouli, Oud, Amber, Musk, Leather, Sandalwood, Tobacco & Labdanum absolute Year: 2020 Content: Unisex eau de parfum – 30ml / 1.0 fl. oz. Origin: London, United Kingdom Bottle dimensions: H 9cm x W 5cm x D 5cm Material: Handmade glass Perfumer: Euan McCall Packaging dimensions: H 12.5cm x W 7.5cm x D 6cm As a way of artistic response to ontological questions and the history of mankind, artist Kentaro Yamada in collaboration with perfumer Euan McCall created Neandertal® Perfume. Neandertal® Perfume imagines the life of this mysterious being while raising questions of the past and future of modern humans. The results are contemporary, highly original, and expe- rimental fragrance structures which are free from conventional and traditional perfumery standards. One a darker, smokier more animalic interpretation of the concept and the other a brighter facet containing higher levels of light, delicate and fresh materials. Woven through both scents is a hot mineral accord, taking inspiration from the hot flint aroma produced during the knapping process. The resulting accord is an overdose of several high-impact, steroidal odorants against lighter aquatic elements to recreate this sensation. The Neandertal stoneware perfume bottle is slip cast from a flint knapped hand-axe then fired and vitrified at over 1400°C. Each bottle is handmade by the artist Kentaro Yamada.

results.name: Creed Royal Oud EDP 50ml
results.description: Creed Royal Oud EDP 50ml — A Luminous Architecture of Oud Creed Royal Oud EDP 50ml presents oud through clarity, proportion and modern refinement. Grapefruit and cardamom create a sparkling spiced opening; angelica and geranium bring aromatic poise to the heart; and oud, incense, benzoin and cedarwood form a deep yet polished base. The 50ml full retail bottle is ideal for fragrance rotation, formal wear and gifting. Royal Oud has presence, but its elegance comes from restraint: the oud is framed by citrus, aromatics and dry woods rather than allowed to dominate the entire composition. Royal Oud at a Glance Fragrance style: Woody fresh, spicy and smoky Concentration: Eau de Parfum Top notes: Grapefruit and cardamom Heart notes: Angelica and geranium Base notes: Oud, incense accord, benzoin and cedarwood Format: 50ml full retail spray bottle Best suited to: Formal occasions, business, dinners, cooler weather and distinguished signature wear A Different Way to Wear Oud Royal Oud avoids the dense, medicinal or overtly animalic character sometimes associated with oud fragrances. Instead, Creed constructs a luminous woody composition in which grapefruit creates space, cardamom supplies warmth and angelica with geranium keeps the heart aromatic and composed. The base is stately rather than heavy. Incense adds a fine smoky veil, benzoin contributes smooth warmth, cedarwood provides structure and oud gives the fragrance depth and distinction. The result feels architectural, polished and quietly commanding. The Olfactive Architecture Grapefruit and Cardamom: Brightness with Spice Grapefruit opens with a dry, sparkling freshness, while cardamom adds aromatic heat and refinement. The contrast creates immediate elegance and prevents the fragrance from beginning too darkly. Angelica and Geranium: The Composed Heart Angelica brings a green, slightly earthy character, while geranium adds fresh aromatic lift. Together they bridge the citrus-spice opening and the deeper woods, giving Royal Oud its tailored sense of proportion. Oud, Incense, Benzoin and Cedarwood: The Majestic Base Oud and cedarwood create the fragrance’s structural core. Incense introduces smoke and shadow, while benzoin softens the composition with a refined resinous warmth. The dry-down is elegant, enduring and richly textured without becoming overwhelming. How Royal Oud Develops on Skin The opening is brighter than the name may suggest, led by grapefruit and cardamom. It’s a planet covered with warm velvet dunes where the spicy and caramelised everlasting flower is preponderant. The fiery heart of this fragrance reminds us that the gods gave Ganymede eternal life so that his beauty would never fade. Is it the smouldering skin hidden underneath the wild leather? results.name: Azalai Extrait de Parfum - 30ml
results.description: The Azalai is a caravan route through the Ténéré region of the Saharan desert where camel trains have transported salt and gold for a thousand years. Along the route stood one single acacia tree - the only living thing in an ocean of sand. This acacia, known simply as The Tree of Ténéré , was the last surviving plant from a time when the desert was less parched than it is today, thanks to roots reaching deep down into a water pocket, an underground pool hidden more than 30 meters below the desert. It’s easy to see how the Tuareg caravan riders, themselves desert survival specialists, held the tree and its amazing fortitude in highest regard. Breaking its branches for firewood or letting the camels eat from the leaves were considered blasphemy. This loneliest tree in the world was one of very few landmarks along the Azalai - a sacred testament to the resilience of life - that had guided caravans for centuries. In spite of this, and the fact that it was the only obstacle for miles around, a truck driver that had drunkenly fallen asleep behind the wheel crashed into it in 1973, and killed it. The scent is an olfactory impression of gold, with radiant warmth from saffron and blood orange, and the glossy, luxurious musk velvione (a material that has been described as pressing the nose to the skin of a newborn’s scalp). Gum acacia, a syrup made from acacia sap, provides sugary sweetness balanced by salty amber and incense. A touch of mint tea and dried fruit pays homage to the Tuareg caravan riders. results.name: Fantome De Maules Extrait de Parfum - 30ml
results.description: What is Fantôme de Maules? Who is Fantôme de Maules? The setting: Maules , a small village in the French-speaking part of Switzerland, surrounded by agricultural fields and dense forests. The subject: an enigmatic being, seen by many wandering the local woodlands for the past decade, dressed in nothing but cloaked camouflage and an obsolete mask. Most likely human but one cannot be sure. Looming at almost two meters tall, he seems to take particular interest in the surrounding flora and fauna. Unaware of passersby, he spends his time picking and smelling flowers; only then he lets down his guard. A crack of a twig or the rustle of a leaf and he'll vanish back into the foliage. The locals call him Le Loyon , but the character calls himself Fantôme de Maules . The ghost of Maules. So who is Fantôme de Maules? A recluse, an outcast from society who has made a home in the forest? A survivalist preparing for the apocalypse? We will never know, because he doesn't want us to. And perhaps that's what makes Fantôme de Maules a character with such a riveting mystery. The modern world is alight with information and the shadows are shrinking. It is rare to come across someone who doesn't feel it is necessary to explain himself. results.name: Hexensalbe Extrait de Parfum - 30ml
results.description: “In rifleing the closet of the ladie, they found a pipe of oyntement, wherewith she greased a staffe, upon which she ambled and galloped through thick and thin, when and in what manner she listed.” -Proceedings Against Dame Alice Kyteler, Prosecuted for Sorcery, 1324 Hexensalbe, also known as witches’ flying ointment, was a hallucinogenic salve used in witchcraft in the Middle Ages. It was a mixture of extremely poisonous ingredients. The drug produced an ecstatic trance with powerful sensations of flying, images of otherworldly creatures, and a primal sexual hunger. These hallucinations are at the core of the mythology of witches, where they fly to the sabbath at Blåkulla or Brocken to do it with the devil and other witches in unholy rites. So, the image of witches flying can be traced back to the use of hexensalbe - but why on a broomstick? The ointment was so poisonous that eating it would be directly fatal, instead it was applied to other soft membranes of the body, armpits and more commonly the genitals. Because of the erotic effects of the high, the salve would often be rubbed directly onto a phallic object like the end of a staff or a broomstick. And so, the witch did not ride the broomstick like we picture her today. She actually really rode it. Given which aspects of the story of hexensalbe have survived into the modern image of witches, and what has been suppressed, it would seem that the one thing more terrifying than witches or devils, is female sexuality. results.name: Mistpouffer Extrait de Parfum - 30ml
results.description: “Like trying to catch smoke with your bare hands.” — Bem, Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban A Mistpouffer is an unexplained natural sound — a sonic boom like distant cannon fire that seems to come out of the fog over large lakes or rivers. It has been recorded all over the world throughout history and is the source of many legends. In Japan, the phenomenon is called uminari , meaning “cries from the sea.” In Connecticut, the Machimoodus State Park gets its name from the Native American word for the area, which means “place of bad noises.” Despite scientific attempts to understand the sounds (that can still be heard to this day), their source has never been identified. Possible explanations include solar winds resonating in the atmosphere, underground earthquakes, or gas bubbles being released from the deep. Others believe it is the work of extraterrestrial or subsurface civilizations. Early settlers in North America were told by the Haudenosaunee Iroquois that the booms were the sound of the Great Spirit continuing his work of shaping the earth. Rendering this mystical water thunder as a fragrance was as elusive as the sound itself. We spent four years and hundreds of iterations before finding the right balance between being distinctive and inexplicable. Foggy but not aquatic, smoky but not heavy. Natural — but in equal parts, supernatural. results.name: Monkeyflower Extrait de Parfum - 30ml
results.description: Monkeyflower opens like a sun-warmed meadow in late summer: a soft hum of tussilago and the dry, salt-skin warmth of sunscreen, the kind of scent that smells like an afternoon you don't want to end. Underneath, fig and buttercup tangle with chamomile and goldberry, herbaceous and slightly sticky, before settling into a quiet base of musk and dried hay. The name nods to the Musk Monkeyflower, a Victorian-era houseplant once prized for its rich musk scent that, at the turn of the twentieth century, mysteriously and permanently lost its fragrance. Stora Skuggan's tribute is part botanical eulogy, part wearable folklore, and very much its own thing on skin: warm, golden, a little wild around the edges. Notes Top: Tussilago, Sunscreen Heart: Fig, Buttercup, Chamomile, Goldberry Base: Musk, Hay Specifications 30ml Extrait de Parfum Handcrafted in Stockholm, Sweden Contains: Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Aqua, Hydroxycitronellal, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Limonene, Benzyl Salicylate, Linalool, Citronellol, Eugenol, Geraniol About Stora Skuggan Stora Skuggan, meaning "The Great Shadow" in Swedish, is a niche perfume house handcrafted in Stockholm. Founded in 2015 by five multidisciplinary design students, every fragrance is a scented story that blends folklore, surrealism and playful storytelling into something completely original. From the licorice-drenched Hexensalbe to the mysterious Moonmilk, each scent is a wearable artwork, conceived and produced entirely by hand, from formula to packaging. The name references a remote area of northern Sweden known for its untouched natural beauty. Wally is proud to be one of the few Stora Skuggan NZ stockists, carrying a curated selection of their distinctive fragrances.

results.name: Moonmilk Extrait de Parfum - 30ml

It gathers in the ceiling and makes the limestone stalactites glitter and gleam, dripping tears of white liquid into puddles on the rock floor that never dries. Moonmilk.” Notes Top: Black Tea, Lime Mid: Cardamom, Lily-of-the-Valley, Mandarin, Black Pepper Base: Sandalwood (Mysore) Ingredients Alcohol Denat., Parfum, Aqua, Hydroxycitronellal, Linalool, Limonene, Citral, Geraniol, Farnesol Safety Cosmetic product for external use only. results.description: Inspiration : A day at Bondi Beach, Australia's legendary beach, with its ultra-popular surf spot and relaxed atmosphere. Good vibes only! Description : A floral, mineral and salty fragrance, reminiscent of long hours spent at the beach, between salty hair and sun-drenched skin. Main notes : Ylang-ylang Essence, Solar Amber, Coconut, Geranium Essence, Marine Notes, Tree Moss, White Musks, Ambroxan Perfume concentrates are diluted in an oily base of 100% natural ingredients. Perfume oils are applied directly to the skin, on pulse points, also known as hot spots. So, we advise you to roll the ball of your bottle on the inside of your wrists, the hollow of your elbows, in your neck, behind your knees and anywhere you feel your heart beating. And our favourite tip, on the ends of the hair! ====================== Elaïo, a unique perfume house, reinvents the olfactory elegance and emotions of fine perfumery in signature creations for more spontaneity and softness with the skin. The sincerity of a unique and spontaneous perfumery From the ancient Greek ἔλαιον, which means oil, Elaïo offers modern and sincere perfumery by choosing to develop an exclusive oil for the formulation of its perfumes. Elaïo expresses a spontaneous perfumery, without make-up, without filter, without superfluity, which projects us closer to the very essence of the perfume, like a gesture of love for oneself, where only emotion guides us. The promise of long-lasting and faithful fragrances, all day long, to express your true character.

results.name: NASOMATTO BARAONDA 30ML
results.description: Baraonda is a liquored-up lullaby; boozy, blurry, and brimming with heat. It slips between sweet and smoky, like the ghost of a kiss in a darkened bar. You do not wear it, you drink it in. The morning after a scandal, lipstick still intact. Musk, Whiskey, Rose, Woody Notes NASOMATTO/ Baraonda A mysterious addition to the Nasomatto line, Baraonda comes with few clues attached. The name means “chaos” or “uproar” in Italian, but the fragrance itself is subtle and almost transparent. The nose of this fragrance warns us that it will evoke “a raw taste sensation”….but what we taste is both comforting and refined. Baraonda smells like the pleasures of fall, painted with a light hand. A tumbler of whiskey held up to catch the glow from an open fire. Delicate little glass bowls holding red berries, quince, and apples baked slowly until they fall apart. An old book, open on the lap, filling the air with the dry, papery scent of lignin. A hint of caramelized wood resin dancing around the edges of the room but never closing in. Baraonda takes the heavy oil paints of the boozy-gourmand genre and uses them to make a watercolor so exquisite that it will have you savoring its taste on your tongue long after you’ve worn it.

results.name: NASOMATTO BLACK AFGANO 30ML
results.description: Nasomatto Black Afgano, This Perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. This fragrance aims to evoke the best quality of hashish. It is the result of a quest to arouse the effects of temporary bliss. A rich and hypnotic scent, with dark notes of Coffee, Oud, Tobacco. Black Afgano is a strong smoke and incense fragrance that is surprisingly never overpowering. Dense smoke, dry woods, narcotic haze. Black Afgano does not speak, it pulls you under. Its hypnotic swirl of hash, oud, and tarry resins is unapologetically intense. It clings like a secret. Coffee, Oud, Tobacco, Hash

results.name: NASOMATTO BLAMAGE 30ML
results.description: A beautiful accident. Blamage leans into chaos with charm; creamy, smoky, woody, floral all somehow stitched together with bravado. It should not work. And yet it's glorious. A wrong turn that leads to the best night of your life. White Woods, Leather, Birch, Musk Blamage ("disgrace" in German) may be a testament to mistakes and failures, but the result is as vibrantly intoxicating as each of its predecessors in the now-complete Nasomatto line. Inspired by legends of classic fragrances that achieved their unique character through mistakes in the design process, Gualtieri blindfolded himself, choosing four key (and undisclosed) ingredients at random. The perfume was painstakingly constructed from there, a process (portrayed in the upcoming documentary film "The Nose- Searching For Blamage") that took Gualtieri around the world and, supposedly, almost to the breaking point.

results.name: NASOMATTO DURO 30ML
results.description: Hard-edged and unapologetic, Duro is all cedar, spice, and swagger. There's nothing shy here, it barrels in, lights a cigar, and leans back with a raised brow. Chest hair, leather belt, knows how to start a fire (and probably a fight). Leather, Woods, Spices

results.name: NASOMATTO FANTOMAS 30ML
results.description: Fantomas is enigmatic and metallic, a perfume built on illusion. It's synthetic, sci-fi, sleek, a scent that hides more than it reveals. You won't know what hit you, but you'll like the bruise. A silver glitch in the matrix, grinning in the shadows. Cedar, Calamus, Amber, Musk

results.name: NASOMATTO MICODELIRIO 30ML
results.description: This bottle of perfume is part of the project Nasomatto. The fragrance is the result of a natural vital delirium, evoking a flourishing ecosystem of organic disobedience. Like wandering into a forest and forgetting why you ever needed directions. Earthy, green and quietly intoxicating, Micodelirio blurs the line between logic and instinct. It celebrates the beautifully irrational moments that lead to the best stories, the boldest ideas and the most unforgettable versions of ourselves. The Scent Stack Earth • Green Notes • Woods 30ML Extract de Parfum

results.name: NASOMATTO NARCOTIC VENUS 30ML
results.description: All bloom and no restraint. Tuberose, jasmine, and lily writ large, Narcotic V is floral excess with a provocative wink. It does not ask for attention; it takes it. A femme fatale in full bloom; dangerously pretty, and she knows it. Tuberose, Jasmin, Lily, Spices

results.name: NASOMATTO NUDIFLORUM 30ml
results.description: Nudiflorum is sheer intimacy, soft musk, tender leather, skin against skin. It's not perfume, it's proximity. Primitive and almost uncomfortable in its closeness. That pause before someone leans in. Jasmine, Leather Nasomatto Nudiflorum is the result of a quest to find a vanishing point in nature. It is natural, primitive and sensual, an interpretation of a feeling of being touched. Using notes of jasmine, leather and musks, it invites you to undergo the unexpected tranquility of giving up oneself without concern for a boundary. Presented with a handmade wooden cap. Made in Italy. Nudiflorum is no typical jasmine, for it hums a dissonant tune. Big top notes of cold sherbet-like aldehydes move into a picture of jasmine suffocated with leather, washed in a hot glow of sensual white musk and soft rubbery smoke. Nudiflorum smells intimate and licentious, revealing a devious edge beyond first glances.

results.name: NASOMATTO PARDON 30ML
results.description: Refined but not remote. Pardon blends chocolatey woods and florals with the polish of a man who knows the weight of silence. Elegant, seductive, a touch of sin in a well-cut suit. Velvet voice. Fresh shave. Holds the door and your gaze. Magnolia, Unsweetened Chocolate, Tonka Bean, Cinnamon, Sandalwood

results.name: Clive Christian 1872 Feminine 50ml
results.description: 1r872 Named for the founding year of The Crown Perfumery and the year Queen Victoria granted use of her crown, the 1872 perfume pair came to life after delving into the company’s archives. While strands of an intriguing and complex past come to play in the finished duo (the green glass bottles are signifiers of its apothecary past), each has been updated to reflect today’s tastes. The feminine version is a fruity Citrus redolent of a heavenly wedding bouquet, its citrus top notes including Bergamot, Tangerine and Lemon offer a resolute freshness. In a nod to the brand’s unerring search for the very finest ingredients, the middle note of Rose de Mai contains the distilled absolute of 170 precious rose heads. The perfume’s base notes of Sandalwood, Cedarwood and the unusual Oak Moss add depth and complexity, making it an extraordinarily compelling perfume. The masculine version is a fresh, spicy, citrusy Chypre. Wonderfully rich and with mysterious notes coming from the Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli and green resins lying at the base, in the heart rests the heady aroma of Cyclamen, Freesia, Tagete Oil and Jasmine. Sitting proudly at the top of this complex elixir is Clary Sage, a herb synonymous with the strength and vigour of Emperor Nero. Nestled amongst this king of herbs is the refreshing zing afforded by a zesty trio of Grapefruit, Lime and Bergamot, and the spicy warmth emanating from Rosemary, Black Pepper and Nutmeg. After acquiring the Crown Perfumery Company in 1999, a prestigious perfume house established in 1872, Clive Christian OBE launched the Original Collection in the same year. The first collection to be released, it laid the foundation for exquisite fragrances crafted from extraordinary ingredients all around the world, and would go on to epitomise the perfume house’s devotion to the provenance of these precious materials. The resultof this dedication makes each Clive Christian perfume quite unlike any other; brimming with quality, depth and complexity, they are true moments of luxury. Fragrance is a truly personal entity, capable of evoking memories, stirring sentiments and forging deeply personal attachments. Clive Christian Perfume understands this complex relationship and has created the Original Collection in ode to this. Comprising three individual pairings, No.1, 1872 and X, the perfumes challenge the ordinary in their quest for complexity and creativity, while maintaining distinct individual personalities. Referencing the Crown Perfumery’s illustrious heritage, the collections are simultaneously in tune with modern day tastes

results.description: X A name that conjures up the essence of perfume in its truest and most alluring form, X is a perfume that captivates all those whose path it permeates. Housed in its unmistakable black bottle with discreet gold labelling, X is a secret you don’t want to share and is an alluring nod to the powerful emotions it is capable of invoking. At the heart of X Feminine, a fruity Chypre, lies the essence of two of the world’s most powerfully aphrodisiac powers, the Karo Karounde plant from West Africa and the rare and mystical Egyptian Jasmine, which is grown on the banks of the Nile. While it is the heart that gives it its great seductive pull, the top notes of Bergamot, Peach, Rhubarb and Pineapple and the base notes of Cedarwood and Kashmir Musk add a roundedness that is utterly intoxicating.A spicy, woody Chypre with heady top notes of Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Ginger, X Masculine, embodies a sense of mysticism. results.name: Clive Christian Crab Apple Blossom 50ml
results.description: About Clive Christian: In 1999, Clive Christian took over one of the oldest British perfume houses, The Crown Perfumery. Reviving its original values, he created pure perfumes in complex formulas with the most precious natural ingredients. The vision led to the creation of an extraordinary collection of perfumes, including No.1, which is recognized by the Guinness Book of Records as the world's most expensive perfume. Capturing the history, creativity and craftsmanship of the perfume house the limited-edition Anniversary Collection is a celebration of past, present and future in perfumed form. Bottling nearly 200 years of haute perfumery and paying tribute to Clive Christian's inspirational heritage from the Crown Perfumery Company. A beautiful celebration of apple blossom top notes infused by marine bergamot, bitter yuzu, lemon, mandarin and exquisite Citruswood fusion. The sensuous heart of neroli and osmanthus is perfectly balanced with water lily, green rhubarb and a hint of fruity mojito aroma fusion adding unexpected twist to the fragrance. Creamy sandalwood, moss, amber and Kasmirwood fusion enhances the trail of the scent. Top Notes: Marine Bergamot, Lemon Tree, Bitter Yuzu, Apple Blossom, Mandarin, Citruswood fusion Heart Notes: Osmanthus, Neroli, Apricot Blossom, Water Lily, Green Rhubarb, Mojito Aroma fusion Base Notes: Sandalwood, Moss, Musk, Driftwood, Amber, Kashmirwood fusion Olfactive Family: Citrus Aquatic

results.name: Clive Christian Matsukita 50ml
results.description: About Clive Christian: In 1999, Clive Christian took over one of the oldest British perfume houses, The Crown Perfumery. Reviving its original values, he created pure perfumes in complex formulas with the most precious natural ingredients. The vision led to the creation of an extraordinary collection of perfumes, including No.1, which is recognized by the Guinness Book of Records as the world's most expensive perfume. Capturing the history, creativity and craftsmanship of the perfume house the limited-edition Anniversary Collection is a celebration of past, present and future in perfumed form. Bottling nearly 200 years of haute perfumery and paying tribute to Clive Christian's inspirational heritage from the Crown Perfumery Company. The complexity of Clive Christian’s Crown Collection Matsukita pure perfume enriches and emboldens, promising its wearer that their presence will be undeniably felt. From its resounding notes of green bergamot, mate tea and burning amber, this fragrance takes on a regal stance that continues to unfold over time, revealing layers of awe-inspiring triumph. Green bergamot meets sparkling pink pepper and spicy nutmeg for a fresh and invigorating top, laced with a floral and smokey heart of Chinese imperial jasmine and mate tea. Hints of jasmine sambac and guaiac oil complement woody tones, whilst rich amber, fir balsam absolute and whispering musks form a sensual and warm base. A mysterious and complex fragrance crafted with 252 unique ingredients and an outstanding 25% parfum concentration. Top notes: Exquisite green bergamot meets sparkling pink pepper and spicy nutmeg for a fresh and invigorating top. Heart notes: A floral and smokey heart is revealed by delicate Chinese imperial jasmine and mate tea. Hints of jasmin sambac and guaiac oil complements woody tones for a sensual and elegant feel on the skin. Base notes: Rich amber, fir balsam absolute and whispering musks form a sensual and warm finish for a mysterious and complex fragrance.

results.name: Nishane Nefs 50ml
results.description: A luxurious interpretation of the oriental notes. Like Istanbul itself, the masterful creations of Nishane straddle the line between Europe and Asia, synthesising the palettes and traditions of both in the service of dynamic, modern perfumery. And so it's unsurprising that Nefs, conceptualised as the line's flagship oriental scent, strives for a new, modern oriental- an East-meets-West portrait of refined luxury to sway even those who dislike oriental fragrances. Like a breeze blowing from the east across the Bosphorus, Nefs is an exquisite oriental that bridges the gap between civilisations. A scent to revive the fantasies told by the stories of One Thousand and One Nights of the Orient. TOP NOTE Honey, Violet, Sage, Saffron, Fig. HEART NOTE Rose, Osmanthus, Geranium, Jasmine, Nutmeg. BASE NOTE Amber, Whiskey, Oud, Cinnamon, Cedar, Gurjam Balsam, Leather, Vanilla. NISHANE is the first and only Istanbul based niche perfume brand that is celebrated globally with an exceptional point of view on artistic perfumery. This can easily be recognised by the uniqueness of the scent creations. results.name: Clive Christian Addictive Arts Jump Up And Kiss Me Hedonistic 50ml
results.description: This is a woody oriental fragrance with Gourmand, fruity and narcotic notes. It starts with a citrus accord of Bergamot, Grapefruit and Neroli combined with a fruity herbal green accord of black cherry, and Clary Sage. It is followed by Jasmine in the heart with notes of Orris, Tobacco and Papyrus to give sensuality and depth. The base is an oriental woody style, rich with ambers, smoky leather and rich resinous Labdanum, sweetened with a touch of Tonka and Vanilla. About Clive Christian: In 1999, Clive Christian took over one of the oldest British perfume houses, The Crown Perfumery. Reviving its original values, he created pure perfumes in complex formulas with the most precious natural ingredients. The vision led to the creation of an extraordinary collection of perfumes, including No.1, which is recognized by the Guinness Book of Records as the world's most expensive perfume. Capturing the history, creativity and craftsmanship of the perfume house the limited-edition Anniversary Collection is a celebration of past, present and future in perfumed form. Bottling nearly 200 years of haute perfumery and paying tribute to Clive Christian's inspirational heritage from the Crown Perfumery Company.

results.name: Clive Christian Original No.1 Feminine 50ml
results.description: No.1 An emblem of the extraordinary attention to detail that Clive Christian prides itself on, No.1 Masculine and Feminine are sourced and composed using the rarest, most precious ingredients from around the world. Exemplifying the founding pillars of creativity, craftsmanship and provenance as defined by its elegant gold bottle, the No.1 pair is, simply put, the zenith of fragrance creation. No 1 Feminine is a floral Oriental, resplendent with fruity top notes of Pineapple, Plum, and White Peach that are then cut through with spicier notes of Cardamom and Pimento oil. A heart of Jasmine, Carnation and Rose evoke Aphrodite’s gardens of love and beauty, while its base of Tahitian Vanilla, Cedar and creamy Tonka Bean offer a sophisticated and tantalising depth. No 1 Masculine is a woody Oriental; understated yet distinctive. Lush top notes of Bergamot, Lime, Sicilian Mandarin and Pink Grapefruit are spiced up with the tang of Cardamom and Nutmeg, Pimento oil, Thyme and Artemisia oil. At its heart we find Rose, Jasmine and Lily of the Valley, while Heliotrope adds a rare, distinctive note. At the base is rare 50-year-old Indian Sandalwood as well as powdery Musk and Vetiver, the combination of which provides sublime depth for a perfume that speaks to an accomplished and confident individual. After acquiring the Crown Perfumery Company in 1999, a prestigious perfume house established in 1872, Clive Christian OBE launched the Original Collection in the same year. The first collection to be released, it laid the foundation for exquisite fragrances crafted from extraordinary ingredients all around the world, and would go on to epitomise the perfume house’s devotion to the provenance of these precious materials. The resultof this dedication makes each Clive Christian perfume quite unlike any other; brimming with quality, depth and complexity, they are true moments of luxury. Fragrance is a truly personal entity, capable of evoking memories, stirring sentiments and forging deeply personal attachments. Clive Christian Perfume understands this complex relationship and has created the Original Collection in ode to this. Comprising three individual pairings, No.1, 1872 and X, the perfumes challenge the ordinary in their quest for complexity and creativity, while maintaining distinct individual personalities. Referencing the Crown Perfumery’s illustrious heritage, the collections are simultaneously in tune with modern day tastes
